IGUI_UW_Radio_Awareness_01: This weather is messing up my plans... there has to be some way to anticipate it.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Awareness_02: They used to broadcast weather reports on the radio... maybe something is still working out there.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Awareness_03: Every time I go out, something feels different... I’m going to need more information.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Awareness_04: I can’t keep improvising with this kind of weather.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_01: Signs of instability are being detected in the region, though they don’t form a clear pattern yet.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_02: The air shows rapid changes on some sensors, but the overall picture remains uncertain.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_03: Readings don’t fully line up and the overall picture is hard to interpret.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_04: Activity may be developing in upper layers, though it’s still too early to draw conclusions.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_05: Wind and pressure describe an irregular pattern that hasn’t fully defined itself.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_06: Humidity appears to be increasing in some areas, but not consistently across the region.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_07: There are indications of a possible shift, though current data can’t confirm it.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_08: Preventive notice: conditions could become more difficult, though the margin of error remains high.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_09: Signal noise makes it hard to separate a real anomaly from simple randomness.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_10: The region is entering a zone of low stability, but its evolution is still unpredictable.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_11: Models disagree with each other, reducing the reliability of the current forecast.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_12: The next few hours remain uncertain, with very different scenarios on the table.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_13: Constant variations are observed, but they fail to consolidate into a clear trend.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_14: Some weak signals repeat themselves, though they don’t yet indicate a defined phenomenon.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_15: The atmosphere is showing unusual behavior, difficult to correlate at the moment.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_16: There is no solid confirmation, but today’s uncertainty margin is especially wide.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_17: Rapid changes could occur, though it’s also possible they won’t materialize.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_18: The situation may shift quickly, readings will continue to be monitored.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_19: Scattered reports suggest localized irregularities, without clear continuity.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Alert_20: General notice: today the atmosphere is proving difficult to read.

IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_False_02: Conditions remain within typical ranges, with no notable signals at the moment.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_False_03: Sky and pressure appear stable, though it’s never wise to get too comfortable.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_False_04: Most sensors show mild readings, with no standout patterns so far.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_False_05: The environment continues to behave normally, with only minor variations possible.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_False_06: Everything fits within expectations, though these readings can shift without warning.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_False_07: No clear pockets of instability detected at this time.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_False_08: An ordinary day according to current data, any rumors remain unconfirmed.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_False_09: The signal comes through clean, with no obvious anomalies for now.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_False_10: Routine report underway, the outlook shows no significant changes at the moment.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Interrupt_01: Central desk to all receivers... hold on, someone’s knocking at the door... *STATIC*.
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Interrupt_02: Wait— there’s movement outside the tower... do you hear that? ... *SCREAM* ... signal lost...
IGUI_UW_Radio_Forecast_Interrupt_03: Weather network reporting... repeat... is that interference or...? *MIC HIT*.

IGUI_PD_AlertFullDesc: Full watch over the whole sentinel range. A quiet growl for distant or few zombies; a loud bark for close, many or visible ones - and that bark draws zombies (the trade-off). The default.
IGUI_PD_AlertQuietDesc: Stealth watch: only a small nearby ring, and never more than a quiet growl and a halo - no loud bark, no noise that draws zombies. A discreet heads-up that won't give away your position.
IGUI_PD_AlertSilentDesc: No zombie alerts at all from this %1's sentinel. (Its stress barking from hunger or injury is separate and still happens.)
IGUI_PD_AutoProtectDesc: Your %1 stands guard while you do something that leaves you defenseless - sleeping, eating, reading, sitting or fishing. It anchors next to you and fights zombies off, then goes back to following the moment you're done. Fighting like this stresses the dog (it barks and draws zombies) and earns no loyalty, so use it wisely. Off by default; toggle it per dog.
IGUI_PD_BadFood: Bad for dogs - eating this makes it sick and breaks its trust.
IGUI_PD_BagMapNoAnnot: Map markings aren't kept in the saddlebag.
IGUI_PD_BowlHasFood: The bowl has food - empty it to add water.
IGUI_PD_BowlHasWater: The bowl has water - empty it to add food.
IGUI_PD_BowlNeedFood: You have no dog food to add.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_bordercollie: A bright, tireless herding dog and the classic farm companion, prized above all for its intelligence. For now it is a balanced all-rounder with no standout specialty. Stray Border Collies turn up around barns and farmsteads out in the countryside.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_caramelo: The caramelo is a basic, everyday breed - the mongrel you find all over the cities. It has no special skills and is weak by nature: it can't kill a zombie on its own, only knock one down to buy you time. The plain baseline that future breeds will improve on.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_germanshepherd: A powerful, intelligent working dog. Born far stronger and tougher than the caramelo, it learns Combat and Obedience quickly, barely frays in a fight (a third of the stress), holds the line against a swarm without panicking, and can bring a zombie down on its own. Rare - found around police and military buildings.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_husky: A hardy northern sled dog: by far the strongest breed, built to haul cargo (its saddlebag carries the most) and to survive the cold. It learns Combat a little faster than the caramelo and can bring a zombie down, but it is no warrior. Stubborn (slower to learn Obedience), friendly (a poor guard) and a big eater (gets hungry fast). Rare - found only in the cold of winter, and at pet shops and vets.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_retriever: A friendly, keen-nosed gun dog and a natural hunter: it learns Hunting twice as fast and Combat a little faster than the caramelo, and can bring a zombie down on its own (though it frays more easily than the German Shepherd). Its nose helps you forage and track game from farther away. Uncommon - turns up now and then in residential houses.
IGUI_PD_BtnReleaseDesc: Send your companion back to the wild. It keeps its training and skills, so you can tame it again later.
IGUI_PD_BtnRenameDesc: Give your companion a custom name (up to 30 characters). It sticks through save and reload.
IGUI_PD_CareAlertZombie: %1 senses a zombie near the pen!
IGUI_PD_CareDeselectConfirm: Assign %1 to care for the livestock here? %1 will be deselected and will no longer follow you, a caretaker works on its own. You can select the dog again at any time to bring it back.
IGUI_PD_CareDeselectWarn: Assigning deselects the dog: a caretaker works on its own instead of following you.
IGUI_PD_CareModeDesc: When on, the %1 stays in this pen (a designated animal zone), keeps the herd calm to protect milk and wool, and silently drives off zombies that get close. It works on its own even when you are away. Only a trained, loyal, calm dog calms the herd; an untrained or panicked dog will not. While assigned it looks after itself: it does not get hungry or thirsty and does not lose loyalty.
IGUI_PD_CareNoPen: %1 needs a designated animal pen here to care for livestock.
IGUI_PD_CareOffMsg: %1 will stop caring for the livestock.
IGUI_PD_CareOnMsg: %1 will care for the livestock here.
IGUI_PD_CmdFetchDesc: Whistle your %1 to teleport instantly to your side - for when it is stuck or loaded but too far to walk back. The loud whistle draws zombies, the cost of an instant recall.
IGUI_PD_CmdFollowDesc: The %1 paths along behind you and fights zombies that get close. Its sentinel keeps watch. The default - your companion on the move.
IGUI_PD_CmdGuardDesc: The %1 anchors to this exact spot and defends it - engaging zombies in a wider radius, alerting, then returning to its post after a chase. It backs off behind you if surrounded. (For now it only works while you are nearby.)
IGUI_PD_CmdStayDesc: The %1 holds its position and won't follow. It still senses and warns about zombies, but it won't chase or fight - it just sits and watches. Good for parking it somewhere safe.
IGUI_PD_DishFull: The bowl doesn't have room for all of that.
IGUI_PD_DishGone: The dish is no longer there.
IGUI_PD_DishNoSpace: No room to place the dish here.
IGUI_PD_DishNoWater: You need a water container to fill it.
IGUI_PD_DogLost: %1 has gone missing! Open My Dogs (paw button) to call it back.
IGUI_PD_DrivingDisabledTip: Not available while driving, your companion is riding with you.
IGUI_PD_ForageFound: Your %1 found something! Turn on Search Mode to see it.
IGUI_PD_GeneDesc_aggressiveness: Fighting drive. A more aggressive %1 earns combat XP faster, so it learns to fight quicker. It does not change when the %1 decides to engage or retreat.
IGUI_PD_GeneDesc_resistance: Toughness. Higher Resistance keeps the %1 calmer under fire, so it gains less stress while fighting.
IGUI_PD_GeneDesc_strength: Raw muscle. Higher Strength makes the %1 hit a little harder in combat.
IGUI_PD_GenomeDesc: Inborn genes, fixed for life - rolled when the %1 is tamed and varying from one to the next. Unlike skills they never change with training; they are the raw nature this %1 was born with.
IGUI_PD_HuntDelivered: Your %1 dragged its kill to you.
IGUI_PD_HuntModeDesc: When on, your %1 tracks wild game while following you and - once trained enough - chases it down: killing small game for you and wearing large game like deer down for you to finish. Hunting is a rural activity (you find game in forests and the countryside, not in town). The cost is symmetric: the dog leaves your side and is exposed, the chase barks and can draw zombies, large game can hurt it, it can wander off, and hunting works up an appetite. Off by default; toggle it per dog.
IGUI_PD_HuntTrackWounded: Your %1 is tracking the wounded game...
IGUI_PD_HuntWoundedDeer: Your %1 wounded a deer - finish it off!
IGUI_PD_KennelRecallConfirm: Call %1 back from afar? Your loud whistle will draw zombies.
IGUI_PD_KennelStatusNoData: No record yet, visit this dog once
IGUI_PD_KennelTooltip: All your bonded dogs - even the ones far away.
IGUI_PD_KillsDesc: Zombies and wild game this dog has killed. Turn on the sandbox option to also add zombie kills to your own count.
IGUI_PD_LoyaltyDesc: How much the %1 trusts you. It slowly fades over time - faster while it's hungry or thirsty - and is restored by feeding, giving water and petting. If it drops too low the %1 turns disobedient, refusing to follow or fight until you win it back. The Obedience skill keeps it reliable at lower loyalty.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BreedHappy_desc: The Caramelo is a wonderfully affectionate, charismatic mutt - its loyal company lifts your spirits, so sadness and boredom fade faster while it's near.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_CollieHerding_desc: Your border collie works the herd with you. While it stays close, fed and loyal, the animals around you settle down, and you learn Animal Care and Farming faster.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_GSCourage_desc: A bold German Shepherd at your side steadies your nerves - its fearless presence eases your panic while it stays close.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_GoldenNose_desc: Your Golden Retriever works the ground with you. While it stays close, fed and loyal, you spot forage from farther away and learn Foraging, Trapping and Aiming faster.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Hunger_desc: Your dog is hungry. Feed it before its health starts to suffer.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Rested_desc: You slept soundly with your dog watching over you. For a while you feel calm and rested - panic, stress, sadness and boredom fade faster, and you tire more slowly.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Sick_desc: You fed it something dogs shouldn't eat - your dog is intoxicated and feeling ill.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Thirst_desc: Your dog is thirsty. Give it water before its health starts to suffer.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Warmed_desc: Your husky pulls its weight at your side. While it stays close, fed and loyal, it shoulders a little of your load so you can carry more and helps you keep your wind, so you tire more slowly; and when the cold sets in, its thick coat keeps you warm.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_health: The %1's life. Fighting no longer wounds it (that only stresses it) - health falls only from real neglect, as severe hunger or thirst drains it, and at zero it dies for good. It heals slowly while fed, watered and out of combat.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_hunger: Rises over time; feeding lowers it. Hunger throttles healing - a fed %1 recovers wounds fastest, the recovery slows as hunger climbs and stops once it passes the halfway mark. Very high hunger also drains the %1's health directly.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_stress: Builds from hunger, thirst, low loyalty and FIGHTING - every strike agitates the %1, more when it's swarmed. A stressed %1 barks on its own, drawing zombies; if it peaks into panic it won't fight, guard or keep watch - though it still flees to you when you call it. Combat stress winds down on its own out of a fight, and petting, feeding or watering calms it faster. The Stress gene sets how easily it frays.
IGUI_PD_NeedDesc_thirst: Rises over time; giving water lowers it. Like hunger, thirst throttles natural healing - the thirstier the %1, the slower it recovers, stopping past the halfway mark. Severe thirst also drains its health directly.

IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_combat: Fighting prowess. Raises the damage it deals and toughens it against bites while it fights.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_herding: The dog's instinct to tend livestock. Simply watching over a pen with animals in it already trains the dog; holding the herd back from panic or driving off a zombie trains it faster. Higher levels calm the herd more strongly, protecting milk and wool production. Border Collies learn it twice as fast.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_hunt: The dog's hunting instinct. It levels up by pointing game and foraging. L0: points game and sniffs out frogs/bugs. L3: takes small game (rabbit, raccoon). L6: takes on deer and brings the kill back.
IGUI_PD_SkillDesc_obedience: Discipline and training. Keeps the %1 reliable at lower loyalty, lowering its disobey threshold.

IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_beagle: A working rabbit dog: an outstanding nose backed by real hunting drive. Famously deaf to recall, weak-biting, and unable to knock a zombie down.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_belgianmalinois: The pack's fighter: the fastest combat learner, the sharpest bite, and the steadiest under pressure. Carries little, and has next to no nose or stock sense.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_bernesemountaindog: A draft dog that works stock and hauls. Second only to the Heeler at herding and to the Dane at carrying, but it is no fighter.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_bloodhound: The finest nose in the pack by a wide margin, bought with the worst obedience of any breed. It follows the trail, not you.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_blueheeler: The pack's herding specialist, and the only light-framed dog that can knock a zombie down. Steady nerves, but a poor nose and almost no hunting drive.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_dachshund: The only dog in the pack that cannot kill. A burrow specialist with the third-best nose of any breed here: it finds everything, finishes nothing, and carries almost nothing.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_greatdane: Hits harder and carries more than anything else in the pack, but it is a gentle giant with no standout skill and the shortest nerve of the big breeds.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_greyhound: Runs anything down and brings nothing back. The best hunter in the pack, and also the frailest, thinnest-skinned, and quickest to lose its nerve.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_jackrussell: The only small dog that fights. Tenacious and fearless, but the quickest in the pack to wind itself up, stubborn, weak-biting, and a minimal carrier.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_newfoundland: The nursemaid: the most obedient of the giants, the gentlest temperament in the pack, and a soft mouth that returns kills from early on.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_saintbernard: Unshakeable. The toughest constitution and the highest panic threshold in the pack, a heavy carrier, and a good nose behind the true scent hounds.
IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_standardpoodle: The most obedient breed in the pack and the only true soft mouth: it retrieves kills from the very first hunt. Weak in a fight.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15Company_desc: A loyal, well-cared-for dog at your side lifts your spirits.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillAiming_1: Control your breathing. Squeeze the trigger, don't pull it. And focus on the front sight — everything else blurs, and that's fine.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillAiming_2: Training. Muscle memory kicks in when your brain shuts down from fear. Dry fire every night if you can — repetition is everything.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillAiming_3: Panicking and shooting fast. You'll miss and waste ammo. Slow down, aim, and make the shot count. Ammo is survival.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_1: Always measure twice, cut once. And keep your tools sharp — a dull saw is dangerous and sloppy.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_2: Solid joints make solid structures. Learn to nail and screw properly and you can build almost anything.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_3: Double up the walls, brace the corners, and always build on a proper foundation. Shortcuts get people killed.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCooking_1: You'd be surprised what you can do with canned goods and a fire. Season everything, and never waste fat — it adds flavor and calories.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCooking_2: Smell it, look at it. If it smells off or has mold, toss it. When in doubt, cook it — heat kills most things.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillCooking_3: Stews. One pot, water, and whatever you find. Boil it long enough and almost anything becomes edible.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillElectrical_1: Generators are your best bet. Keep the fuel fresh, don't overload it, and run it away from where people sleep — carbon monoxide kills silently.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillElectrical_2: Never touch anything live. Always cut power first. Circuit breakers exist for a reason — if one trips repeatedly, something is wrong upstream.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillElectrical_3: Match wire gauges, secure all connections, and insulate everything. Bad insulation causes fires. Fires out here are a death sentence.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFarming_1: Good soil, water, sunlight, and patience. Raised beds help — they drain better and keep pests away from the roots.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFarming_2: Potatoes and beans. They grow fast, don't need much, and give you calories. Tomatoes too, if you have seeds.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFarming_3: Rotate your crops and keep the area clean. Companion planting helps too — some plants keep bugs away from others naturally.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_1: Clean it immediately, always. Pressure stops bleeding. Without antibiotics, infection is what actually kills you — watch for redness and fever.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_2: Antiseptic and bandages. Everything else is secondary. A clean wound that's wrapped properly heals. A dirty one doesn't.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_3: Splint it — any straight, rigid material works. Tie it in place, immobilize the joint, don't let them walk on it. And pray.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillMechanics_1: Check your fluids first — oil, coolant, brake fluid. If it runs, listen for what sounds wrong. Engines talk if you let them.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillMechanics_2: Tire changes and battery swaps. After that, belts and filters. Simple stuff keeps a car alive longer than anything.
IGUI_BanditDialog_A_SkillMechanics_3: Smoke, knocking, seized parts — those are signs it's gone. Otherwise, most things are fixable if you have time and parts.

IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_Concert: I was at a concert when the outbreak news came to everyone's phones. People just... kept dancing. Nobody believed it yet. I miss that kind of ignorance.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_Dog: I had a dog named Rex. Toughest little mutt you ever saw. He saved my life once... I hope he's still out there somewhere.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_Lost: I got lost hiking once. Three days alone in the woods. Thought I was done for. Funny how that feels like a warm-up now.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_Neighbor: There was this old woman on my street who always watched everyone from her porch. Turns out she was the one keeping track of everything. She probably knew it was coming before any of us.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_NightShif: I once locked myself inside my workplace on a night shift. Spent six hours trying to get out. Good training for what came next.
IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Story_RoadTrip: Before all this, my car broke down in the middle of nowhere on a road trip. Spent two days fixing it with zip ties and prayers.

IGUI_BanditDialog_Answer_Surviving: I've been better, but I'm surviving.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_BLOOD_ON_GROUND_3: Louisville red. Not the wine kind.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_BLOOD_ON_GROUND_4: That's a lot. Someone bled out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_BLOOD_ON_GROUND_6: Old blood dries dark. This is fresh.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_BOOK_ON_GROUND_2: Louisville Free Public Library return, apparently.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_BOOK_ON_GROUND_3: Grandpa's saying: 'a book a day keeps the fool away'.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_BOOK_ON_GROUND_4: Wife was a librarian. Would grab this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_BOOK_ON_GROUND_5: Kentucky writer, I bet. Half of them were.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_BOOK_ON_GROUND_6: Half-Price Books tag still on it. Score.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_BROKEN_FURNITURE_3: That was a fine chair once.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_BROKEN_FURNITURE_4: Louisville furniture makers rolling in their graves.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAMPFIRE_1: Somebody camped here. Maybe still around.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAMPFIRE_3: Kentucky woodsmen know how to camp.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAMPFIRE_6: Boy Scouts of America. Miss those days.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_1: Look at that. If we could get it running.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_10: Hood's rusted. Not our lucky day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_13: Engine sounds worse than my ex.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_15: Nashville run would be nice. Wouldn't it?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_17: The keys are probably in a zombie's pocket.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_18: Gonna need a hotwire kit. Or a miracle.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_19: Could siphon that tank. If it's got anything.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_2: American Motors, I reckon. Old style.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_20: Trunk might have supplies. Check it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_22: Fifth wheel around here is rare.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_23: My dad drove Fords his whole life. Only Fords.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_24: Chevy man over here. Never bought foreign.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_26: Bardstown Ford dealer had these on the lot.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_27: GM plant in Bowling Green built these.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_28: Kentucky truck plant made half these engines.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_4: My uncle had one like this back in '85.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_5: Wonder if there's fuel in it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_6: Wife wanted a car like this once. Never got it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_8: Louisville roads never saw many of these.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_9: Tire looks flat. Not that I'd know how to fix it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_NO_KNOWLEDGE_1: Tire looks flat. But I don't know cars.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_NO_KNOWLEDGE_2: Something's leaking. Oil? Grease? Blood? Who knows.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_NO_KNOWLEDGE_3: That noise ain't normal. Or maybe it is. I dunno.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_NO_KNOWLEDGE_4: Never was a mechanic. Wife handled all that.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_NO_KNOWLEDGE_5: Hood's up. That's a bad sign, right?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_NO_KNOWLEDGE_6: Belts, hoses, pistons. Words I know without meaning.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CAR_NO_KNOWLEDGE_7: Dad tried teaching me. I refused. Regret it now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CORPSE_NPC_3: Kentucky lost a good one, I bet.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CORPSE_NPC_6: Grab what you can. Waste nothing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CORPSE_ZOMBIE_1: Another one. Adds to the pile.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CORPSE_ZOMBIE_11: Ohio River gonna get busy with these.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CORPSE_ZOMBIE_12: Sad the way it ended for him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CORPSE_ZOMBIE_7: Should we bury him? Never mind, too many.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_CORPSE_ZOMBIE_9: Wife had a saying: 'every corpse tells a story'.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_DOOR_BARRICADED_1: Somebody boarded this up. Careful inside.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_DOOR_BARRICADED_2: Barricade means people. Or people were here.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_DOOR_BARRICADED_3: Nailed shut. Bad sign or good sign, depends.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_DOOR_BROKEN_2: Fresh damage. They came through here.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_EMPTY_HOUSE_3: Family portrait still on the wall.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_FIRE_2: Smoke means people. Or zombies. Or both.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_FIRE_3: Kentucky wildfires used to be seasonal.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_FIRE_5: Grandpa fought fires for the Louisville dept. Would know what to do.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_FOOD_ON_GROUND_4: Grab it before the flies do.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_10: Fuel tank sounds empty. Not good.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_11: Gonna need a gas can run.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_12: Generator noise attracts them. Necessary evil.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_13: Whoever set this up did well.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_15: Cost a fortune before the world ended.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_16: Diesel? Gas? Bourbon? Whatever it burns.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_17: Miss when this was normal - a hum in every house.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_3: How much fuel is left, I wonder.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_4: Kentucky wired for civilization. Still remembers.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_6: Not sounding right. Fuel? Filter? Something.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_GENERATOR_7: Louisville Gas & Electric would fix this in a jiffy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PHONE_2: Would call my mom. She'd say hi.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PHONE_3: Rotary dial. Grew up on these.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PHONE_5: No dial tone. Never a dial tone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PHONE_6: Bell South. Company's gone. Phones remain.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_DYING_5: Kentucky rain won't save that one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_DYING_7: Deer probably. Or drought. Or death.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_HEALTHY_1: Nice tomatoes. Kentucky soil holds up.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_HEALTHY_10: Homegrown food's the best. Always was.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_HEALTHY_11: Reminds me of the county fair.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_HEALTHY_13: Full-grown cabbages. Would ferment into sauerkraut nice.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_HEALTHY_2: Look at that harvest. Somebody's been busy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_HEALTHY_4: Sweet corn, if I'm not mistaken.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_HEALTHY_5: Fresh food. Actual real fresh food.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_HEALTHY_7: That's a beauty. Rare these days.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_HEALTHY_9: You know how much this'd fetch at market?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_READY_3: Kentucky's finest, ready for the table.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_READY_5: Full ripeness. Amateurs miss this timing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_PLANT_READY_7: Grandma always said 'pick 'em when the sun says'.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_RADIO_3: Sirius satellite would help. Signals gone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_RADIO_5: Grew up on the Waffle House jukebox radio.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_RADIO_6: News radio, weather radio... miss it all.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_RUINED_WALL_3: Wife's brother did construction. He'd cry seeing this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_RUINED_WALL_5: Grandpa built walls to last. Not this one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_STORE_LOOTED_6: Bardstown General looked like this too.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_TV_2: MTV played all day at my apartment.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_TV_5: Cable box just an ornament now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_TV_6: Watched Cardinals games on this size TV.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_WATER_SOURCE_2: Ohio River's polluted. This is better.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_WATER_SOURCE_3: Kentucky springs used to be famous.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_WATER_SOURCE_5: Miss Louisville tap water. Actually miss it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_WEAPON_ON_GROUND_1: Weapon on the ground. Somebody's problem now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_WEAPON_ON_GROUND_3: Grandpa always said 'never pass a good weapon'.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_ENV_WINDOW_BROKEN_3: Grew up learning to sweep glass. Grandma's rules.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXERCISE_1: Gotta stay in shape. Zombies don't rest.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXERCISE_2: P90X made me. Or broke me. Same thing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXERCISE_4: Bally's Total Fitness membership. Waste of money now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXERCISE_6: The old man was a Marine. Discipline sticks.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXERCISE_7: Sweat is fear leaving the body.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXERCISE_9: Cardio saves lives. Zombieland was right.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_AMBIENT_11: {npc}: Bird overhead. Big one. Hawk maybe.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_AMBIENT_19: {npc}: Half moon. Cardinals game would be starting now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_AMBIENT_3: [Radio pop. Distant wind through the mic.]
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ARRIVAL_1: {npc}: Made it to {location}. Starting the sweep.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ARRIVAL_2: {npc}: We're in position. Time to search.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ARRIVAL_4: {npc}: Setting up base camp near {location}. Splitting up to cover more ground.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ARRIVAL_5: {npc}: Arrival at target. Beginning the run.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_APPROACH_1: {npc}: Warehouse ahead has voices inside. Not friendlies. We're going in loud.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_APPROACH_2: {npc}: Camp spotted at {location}. Three, maybe four hostiles. Wish us luck.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_APPROACH_3: {npc}: See smoke from a farmhouse. Someone's home and they got rifles. Pushing in.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_APPROACH_4: {other_npc}: Building looks looted but occupied. Might be trouble. Approaching quiet.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_APPROACH_5: {npc}: (whisper) Got eyes on hostiles. Boss, if we don't check in in twenty, run.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_LOSS_1: {npc}: (heavy breathing) Strangers are down but {casualty} bled out. It was a rifle round.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_LOSS_2: {npc}: We got them. {casualty} didn't get out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_LOSS_3: {other_npc}: They shot first. {casualty} was in the doorway. I'll bring back the boots at least.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_LOSS_4: {npc}: Won the shootout, lost {casualty}. Kentucky math I don't like.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_WIN_1: {npc}: Cleared the hostiles. Warehouse is ours for the taking now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_WIN_2: {npc}: Strangers are done. Recovered their supplies too. It's been a good afternoon.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_WIN_3: {other_npc}: {npc} put a hole through the leader. Rest scattered. Winning day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_WIN_4: {npc}: (relieved laugh) Three hostiles, three shots. Working out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_BANDIT_WIN_5: {npc}: They surrendered when they saw {other_npc}'s eyes. Wise move on their part.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_BANDIT_1: {other_npc}: Strangers ambushed us at {location}. {npc} bled out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_BANDIT_2: {other_npc}: {npc} took a bullet. We're cornered. Signing off.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_BANDIT_3: {other_npc}: They killed {npc} for a can of soup. Fucking soup.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_HORDE_1: {other_npc}: Zeds got {npc} at {location}. Overrun. Couldn't get to him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_HORDE_2: {other_npc}: Lost {npc} to a horde outside {location}. Nothing left to bury.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_HORDE_3: {other_npc}: {npc} took a bite covering my retreat. Had to leave him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_HORDE_4: {other_npc}: {npc} didn't make it. Zeds swarmed too fast.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_INJURY_1: {other_npc}: {npc} fell through a rotted floor. Broken neck.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_INJURY_2: {other_npc}: {npc} caught a nail through the boot. Infection set in fast.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_INJURY_3: {other_npc}: {npc} froze up during a run. Zed got him from behind.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_CASUALTY_INJURY_4: {other_npc}: {npc} bled out from a stranger knife wound. Couldn't save him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_MIXED_1: {npc}: We got the horde but... {casualty} didn't make it. Grabbed from behind. Fast.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_MIXED_2: {npc}: (long pause) We won. {casualty} didn't. Just... report it later.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_MIXED_3: {other_npc}: {casualty} took one for the rest of us. Cleared the way. Bought us seconds.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_MIXED_4: {npc}: Twenty down, one of ours down. Not a trade I'd make again.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_MIXED_5: {npc}: {casualty} slipped on wet floor mid-fight. Nothing we could do fast enough.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_MIXED_6: {npc}: (voice cracking) We got 'em all, boss. All of 'em. Just... {casualty}'s gone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_1: {npc}: Cleared 15 shamblers in the parking lot. No hits taken. Ammo's fine.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_2: {npc}: Twelve of them coming out of a Winn-Dixie. All down. Blades did most of it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_3: {npc}: (breathing hard) Got 'em all. That was closer than I'd like to admit.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_4: {other_npc}: {npc} just took a whole pack out solo. I'm buying him a beer when we're back.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_5: {npc}: Small horde came at us near {location}. Twenty-something? Doesn't matter. Handled.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_6: {npc}: Warehouse was rough. Two dozen inside. All lights out now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_7: {npc}: (spits) That's what we do. Clean sweep, no scratches.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_8: {npc}: Gas station rush ended quick. They came in a line, we picked 'em off.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_COMBAT_WIN_9: {npc}: Cardinals fan would say that was a shutout. Zero deaths on our side.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_1: {npc}: Ran into a family near {location}. Kept my distance.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_2: {npc}: Traders at {location}. Traded a bottle for a road flare.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_3: {npc}: Church group at {location}. Kind people. Fed me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_4: {npc}: Strangers waved me down. Kept walking. They didn't chase.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_5: {npc}: Woman with a rifle at {location}. Told me to keep moving.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_6: {npc}: Man selling info at {location}. Bought a map for a can.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_ENCOUNTER_7: {npc}: Kids playing at {location}. Broke my heart.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_1: Alright, boss. Watch the base while I'm gone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_10: If Danny wakes up asking for me, tell him I'm hunting.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_11: Save my chair by the fire. I'll want it when I get back.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_12: Kroger-run days are over. Now we do real trips.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_13: Wife used to say I looked good in this jacket. Might as well die in it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_14: See you on the other side. Whichever side that is.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_15: I owe you one, boss. This trip won't pay it all back but it's a start.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_16: Don't touch my bourbon while I'm gone. Boss's orders don't apply to bourbon.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_17: Louisville was easier when the roads were clear.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_18: Keep an eye on the perimeter. Strangers love to hit when we're short.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_2: Radio'll be on. Might drop out sometimes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_3: If I don't come back, keep my locker sealed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_4: Two week rations. Should be enough.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_6: Take care of the crew, boss.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_7: Wife would kill me if she was still around to see this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_8: Muldraugh's what, three days of walking? Piece of cake.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FAREWELL_9: Been dying for a real trip. Even one that might kill me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_1: {npc}: Saw survivor tracks near {location}. Not fresh.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_2: {npc}: Stranger camp about a mile from {location}. Avoiding.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_3: {npc}: Working car in {location}. Blue Chevelle. Full tank.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_4: {npc}: Small horde forming east of {location}. Roughly 15.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_5: {npc}: {location} pharmacy's untouched. Someone should hit that later.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_6: {npc}: Water tower at {location} still running. Good to know.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_7: {npc}: Farmhouse near {location}. Fresh food in the garden.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_INTEL_8: {npc}: Radio picked up someone's broadcast near {location}. Voice cut out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_1: {npc}: Boss, there's a mint condition Fender in this pawn shop. Killing me to leave it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_10: {npc}: Poker table in the basement. Full chip set. Not what we came for, but noted.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_11: {npc}: Little league trophy in this kid's room. Weird what makes you tear up.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_12: {npc}: Marlboro carton, still sealed. Boss, permission to take? ...Alright, moving on.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_13: {npc}: TV, VCR, stack of tapes. Weight budget's already blown.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_14: {npc}: Fishing rods. Nice ones. Kentucky lake nostalgia. Leaving them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_2: {npc}: Found a Miles Davis boxed set. On vinyl. Leaving it. Priorities.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_3: {npc}: Porsche 911 in the driveway. Engine block is toast though. Damn.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_4: {other_npc}: Whole crate of Kentucky bourbon. Not on the list but I'm noting it for next time.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_5: {npc}: Ford F-150 with the keys still in it. Tires shredded. So close.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_6: {npc}: Found a Nintendo. Cartridges everywhere. I'm not a monster, I'm leaving them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_7: {npc}: Comic book longbox. Untouched. Killing me. Moving on.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_8: {npc}: There's a Harley in the garage. Kick starter's snapped. Break my heart.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LEAVE_9: {npc}: {other_npc} wants to grab the CD player. We told her no. She's sulking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_1: {npc}: Found a {item} in {location}. Boss's gonna like this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_3: {npc}: {location} hasn't been picked over yet. Grabbing {item}.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_4: {npc}: Nice find - {item}. Whole shelf of them here.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_5: {npc}: You'd love this, boss. Bringing back a {item}.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_7: {npc}: Bagging a {item}. Should keep us going.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_FIND_LOOT_8: {npc}: Kroger warehouse near {location} still has {item} on the shelves.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_INJURY_1: {npc}: Got scratched by a zed at {location}. Bandaged. Fine.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_INJURY_2: {npc}: Twisted my ankle jumping a fence. Slowing me down.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_INJURY_3: {npc}: Cut my leg on debris. Sewed it up with fishing line.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_INJURY_4: {npc}: Stranger graze to my shoulder. Hurts like hell.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_INJURY_5: {npc}: Slept rough last night. Sore all over.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_1: {npc}: Kicked a can of beans and it hit {other_npc} in the head. Been laughing for a mile.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_10: {other_npc}: {npc} is convinced we should adopt a dog if we find one. I'm considering it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_11: {npc}: Discovered these people had a whole shelf of ceramic frogs. Why. Kentucky, why.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_12: {npc}: Karaoke bar. Windows are broken. Machine still works somehow. We're rehearsing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_2: {other_npc}: {npc} just tried to start dancing in the middle of Main Street. I made them stop.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_3: {npc}: Playing hopscotch on the parking lines. Don't tell command.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_4: {npc}: Found a boombox with a working tape. Some Motown. Small joys, boss.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_5: {other_npc}: {npc}'s doing an Elvis impression. Zombies are staying respectfully back.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_6: {npc}: Group's morale is good. Bad jokes helping.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_7: {npc}: Sang the whole Kentucky fight song on the road. Nobody asked me to stop. That's love.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_8: {npc}: Practice piano in a music store. {other_npc} says I got potential.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LEVITY_9: {npc}: Wearing a straw hat now. Found it on a scarecrow. Fits perfectly.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LOOT_LOST_CASUALTY_1: {other_npc}: {npc} was carrying the {item}. Lost when we retreated.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_LOOT_LOST_CASUALTY_2: {other_npc}: The {item} {npc} had is gone. Dropped in the chaos.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_1: {npc}: Was thinking about my sister today. She lived in Chicago. Wonder if it's still there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_A_10: {npc}: My prom was at the Elks Lodge in Elizabethtown. Six of us in a rented Lincoln.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_23: {npc}: I worked at the distillery. Twelve years. Watching bourbon age. Peaceful job.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_24: {npc}: Ford plant in Louisville. Overtime made the year. Truck driver now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_25: {npc}: My cubicle at the insurance office. Man I complained about that cubicle.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_26: {npc}: I was two years into medical school. Never gonna finish now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_27: {npc}: Nursing. RN out of Baptist East. Now I'm still nursing, just different.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_28: {npc}: Bank teller. Nineteen years. Same window at Fifth Third every day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_29: {npc}: Fixed roofs. Kentucky sun'll kill you before zombies get the chance.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_3: {npc}: Bourbon. Real bourbon. Not the swill we're finding in kitchens.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_30: {npc}: I taught fourth grade. Miss those kids. Every one of them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_31: {npc}: Was training to be a firefighter. Almost had the physical passed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_32: {npc}: Meth clinic counselor. Helped a lot of folks. Still needed. More so now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_33: {npc}: Regret not calling my dad more.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_34: {npc}: Should've apologized to my brother. Now I never will.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_35: {npc}: I said things to my wife I can't take back. She's gone. I have to live with it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_36: {npc}: Never went to Europe. Was gonna save up for the anniversary trip. Never got there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_37: {npc}: My daughter's soccer game. Missed for a work call. Still hurts.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_38: {npc}: Never learned to swim proper. Might've saved me at some point.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_39: {npc}: I could've been kinder. Should've been. Too late now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_4: {npc}: Kentucky Fried Chicken. Original recipe. Not the crispy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_40: {npc}: Wish I'd told my mom I loved her more. Kids never do enough.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_41: {npc}: Was gonna quit smoking January first. Turns out I did.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_5: {npc}: BBQ at 610 Magnolia. Best ribs in Louisville. Gone now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_6: {npc}: Mint julep on Derby day. Fresh mint. Crushed ice.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_7: {npc}: Fried catfish and hushpuppies. Nolin Lake. Every Sunday of my childhood.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_8: {npc}: Chocolate gravy over biscuits. Country breakfast. Mom's specialty.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_MUSING_D_9: {npc}: Vinegar-based BBQ. Not that Kansas City sweet stuff.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_QUIET_2: {npc}: Rain today. Sheltering under a bridge.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_QUIET_4: {npc}: Made camp near {location}. Coffee tastes good tonight.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_QUIET_5: {npc}: Long walk today. Radio's the only voice I've heard.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_QUIET_6: {npc}: Miss the base. Boss - how are things?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_QUIET_7: {npc}: Just checking in. All quiet on my end.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_RETURN_ALL_DEAD_2: [No further transmissions received from the expedition.]
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_RETURN_ALL_SURVIVED_: Back, boss. All in one piece.
We made it. Hell of a trip.
Home. Bag's a bit lighter than we hoped.
Everybody accounted for. Boss, get us some water.
That was rough. Beer's on you tonight.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_RETURN_WITH_CASUALTY: Back, boss. Some of us are.
We lost {casualty}. He wanted to be buried at Cave Hill. We couldn't find his body.
It's just me and the bag. {casualty} didn't make it.
{casualty}'s gone. Zeds got him. I'm sorry.
Strangers ambushed us near Bardstown. {casualty} bought us time to escape.
Boss, I owe you a debt. {casualty} died so I could bring this loot back.
{casualty} asked me to give you something. Sealed it in the bag.
We buried {casualty} at a roadside in {location}. Marked with his cap.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_1: {npc}: Saw another survivor across the street. Both of us kept walking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_2: {npc}: Group of maybe six passed north of us. Kept low. They didn't spot.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_3: {npc}: Truck convoy on I-64. Military maybe. Or someone pretending. We stayed off the road.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_4: {npc}: Vulture picking at something in the field. Big one. Kentucky's got its own food chain going.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_5: {other_npc}: Deer. Just a deer. Beautiful. Two-second reprieve.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_6: {npc}: Column of smoke to the south. Someone else is having a worse day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SIGHTING_7: {npc}: Church bells still ringing somewhere. Automated maybe. Chills.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_1: {npc}: Grabbed some batteries. Never enough of those.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_2: {npc}: Two packs of matches. Not glamorous but useful.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_4: {other_npc}: {npc} found a working watch. Time's still moving.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_5: {npc}: Found a photo of somebody's kid. Pocket it. Feels wrong to leave.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_6: {npc}: Half-empty bottle of aspirin. Beats nothing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_SMALL_FIND_7: {npc}: Notebook full of somebody's recipes. Kept the pages.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_10: {casualty} broke his leg falling through a floor.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_11: We tried to splint it. Infection set in fast.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_12: By the fourth day, he was gone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_13: Buried him in the yard of an abandoned Waffle House.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_16: Distracted a horde while I got clear.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_17: I heard him shouting. Then nothing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_18: The loot in that bag is his memorial.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_2: Day three we hit a stranger camp we didn't see.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_20: Four of them. Blocked our route home.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_21: {casualty} charged them so I could flank.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_22: Only I made it back. Kentucky-tough only stretches so far.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_3: {casualty} took the first shot. Never saw who fired.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_4: I dragged the loot out. Couldn't drag him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_7: He asked me to leave him. Said he could hold them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_8: I ran. That's the truth. I ran.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_CASUALTY_9: Boss, I don't sleep good since.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_11: But it still remembers being alive.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_12: Passed my old high school on the way.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_13: Cried for a minute. Kept walking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_15: I was scared out of my skin the whole trip.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_16: Thought I'd die every night I closed my eyes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_17: But here I am. And here's your loot.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_19: Saw a group of survivors near {location}. Well organized.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_20: They looked tough. Might come back for a look.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_21: Worth keeping the perimeter locked down.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_3: Slept in a barn full of dead cows.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_4: Found the {item} on day three. Worth it, boss.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_5: Won't do that again for a while.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_STORY_SURVIVED_9: You picked a good expedition, boss.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_1: {npc}: Setting out from the base. Heading toward {location}.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_10: {npc}: Radio check. Boss - you copy? Just checking in.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_12: {npc}: Feet aching. Blister on my heel. Kentucky-tough, I keep telling myself.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_13: {npc}: Miles crossed. Miles to go. Same as always.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_14: {npc}: Group's holding together. Bag's still empty. Not for long.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_15: {npc}: Almost at target area. Big pharmacy on the map.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_3: {npc}: On the road. Rain kicked in. Cold.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_4: {npc}: Passed the Ohio River bridge. Still walking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_5: {npc}: {other_npc} keeping pace. Good to have company.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_6: {npc}: Slept rough last night. Zeds distant. Sleep restless.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_7: {npc}: Halfway to {location}. Should hit target by morning.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_8: {npc}: Stranger-tracks on the road. Detoured. Costs us an hour.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_TRAVEL_9: {npc}: Passing a farmhouse. Empty. Keeping distance.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_HEAT_1: {npc}: Ninety-five and humid. Kentucky in July. Slowing our pace.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_HEAT_2: {npc}: Sun's brutal. Taking a break under an overpass. Water's low.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_HEAT_3: {npc}: {other_npc}'s red as a beet. Making him drink more.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_NIGHT_1: {npc}: Sun's down. We're hunkered in a diner. Fireflies out. Somehow still Kentucky.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_NIGHT_2: {npc}: Real dark tonight. No moon. Moving with flashlights covered.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_NIGHT_3: {npc}: Owls out. Coyotes too. Feels like being a kid again.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_NIGHT_4: {other_npc}: Setting up watch rotation. {npc} takes first. Four hours.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_RAIN_1: {npc}: Rain came in hard. Sheltering in a Waffle House. Coffee machine works.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_RAIN_2: {npc}: Thunder's rolling. Kentucky spring weather. Radio might cut in and out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_RAIN_3: {npc}: Storm's moving through. Group's holed up in a barn. Cozy actually.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_EXP_WEATHER_RAIN_4: {npc}: (rain on the mic) Not going anywhere for a bit. We'll wait it out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_1: Bardstown. Bourbon capital of the world. Miss it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_2: This got me through my divorce. Twice.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_4: Grandpa: 'Don't drink to forget. Drink to remember.'
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_5: Kaiju off Baxter used to serve this 2 for 1.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_6: Woodford Reserve was my Sunday tradition. RIP.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_7: Buffalo Trace distillery tour saved my Saturday.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_ALCOHOL_8: Kentucky raised me on this. Fitting.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_1: Read this at duPont Manual back in '84. Barely remember.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_2: Books are one of the few good things left.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_3: Louisville Public Library card still in my wallet. Useless. Still there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_4: Been years since I read for fun. This is nice.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_6: Wife was a librarian at Iroquois. Would've loved this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_7: Reading in the apocalypse. Weird times.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_BOOK_8: Half-Price Books on Bardstown Road was my sanctuary.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CAFFEINE_2: Sunergos on Preston. Best coffee in Louisville. Was.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CAFFEINE_3: First cup of the day is holy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CAFFEINE_4: Wife made the best coffee. This isn't hers. But close.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CAFFEINE_5: Heine Brothers or Sunergos was the whole debate. Both gone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CAFFEINE_6: IHOP coffee at 3 AM after prom. Simpler times.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_1: Quit for two years. Then this happened.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_2: First smoke of the day is the best. Then it gets worse.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_3: Marlboro Man died of lung cancer. Ironic.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_4: Dad smoked these. Killed him. Still smoke 'em anyway.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_6: Gas station on Preston Highway sold to underage kids. I miss it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CIGARETTE_7: Camel Lights. Champagne of cigarettes. Overrated.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CLOTHING_2: My old clothes each had a story. All lost.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CLOTHING_4: Gonna smell like me in a week. Sorry.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_CLOTHING_5: Old Navy at Jefferson Mall used to carry this brand.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_1: Last time I saw this was at Kroger on Preston Highway.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_10: K-Mart on Dixie Highway used to stock these.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_11: Church potluck at St. James staple.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_12: Best BBQ was at Feast BBQ in NuLu.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_2: Mom bought this every week at Winn-Dixie.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_3: Rationing this feels wrong. Rationing anything feels wrong.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_4: Camping trips with my brother at Bernheim Forest.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_5: Ate this cold at a shelter once. Not fun.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_6: This brand was my 2 AM go-to in college.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_7: Missing home. Really missing home right now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_8: Grandma's pantry in Bardstown always had these.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_FOOD_9: First real food in three days. Thank you.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_HYGIENE_1: Been three days. Or five. Lost count.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_HYGIENE_2: Water pressure at the shelter was awful. Any wash is good now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_HYGIENE_3: Mom would kill me if she saw my current state.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_HYGIENE_5: Miss my apartment shower on Broadway.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_HYGIENE_6: Old Spice was Dad's stuff. Fitting.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_1: Nurse at Norton Hospital gave me these before... you know.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_2: First aid class at Fern Creek Elementary. Never thought I'd use it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_3: Almost lost my leg at a construction site once. Bandages saved it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_4: You have no idea how bad I needed this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_5: Bandages feel like gold now. Thank you.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_6: Last hospital visit was for a broken wrist. Simpler times.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_7: Mom was a paramedic. This is her area.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_MEDICAL_8: Jewish Hospital had the best ER before... this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_1: Water. Nothing else matters when you're thirsty.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_2: Tap water in Louisville was always weird. This is better.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_3: Grandpa said water tastes best in a canteen. He was right.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_4: Two days without water. You appreciate every drop.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_5: Kids these days don't know real thirst. Well, they do now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_6: Wish I had a lemon slice. Miss those.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WATER_7: Bottled water at Kroger used to be free from the fountain.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_1: This kind saved my life at Fern Creek Plaza outside Muldraugh.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_10: Second Amendment made real sense on day two.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_2: Uncle carried one just like this in Nam. He's the reason I know it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_3: First one I ever fired was at a farm in Bardstown.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_5: Wish I had this on day one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_6: Never thought I'd need a real weapon. Now it's daily.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_7: Father said: 'Respect it, and it'll respect you.'
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_8: Cleaner than what I've been using. Grateful.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_GIFT_WEAPON_9: Bought my first .22 at Cabela's before all this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_HURT_10: I'm not okay. I'm not okay.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_HURT_12: This is it. This is it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_HURT_15: The zombie stole my dignity too.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_HURT_16: Take my blood, I got extra.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_HURT_6: Oh perfect. Just what the day needed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_HURT_7: Sure. Add that to the list.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_HURT_9: Blood. That's a lot of blood.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_1: You know I worked at the Ford Truck Plant?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_10: At least back then, I could help people.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_100: Old soldiers always know what to do.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_102: Fought like cats their whole lives.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_103: But if you messed with one, the other'd bite your ankles off.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_104: Ella made it to a shelter. Emma didn't.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_105: Wonder if Ella still fights without her twin.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_106: Always meant to travel. Never did.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_107: Grand Canyon. Yellowstone. Nashville just an hour away.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_109: Someday's been canceled. Note to self: no more somedays.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_11: Sixth grade at Iroquois Middle School.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_110: Was gonna write a book once. Actually started it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_111: Draft in a shoebox under my bed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_112: House burned down two months into all this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_114: Whole civilization gone. My book gone. Fair enough.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_116: Wife tried to teach me. I was hopeless.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_117: Now I watch the young ones move like they never had bones.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_118: Beautiful. Kind of makes me happy and sad at once.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_119: My mother left three voicemails the week before.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_12: Twenty-two kids in my last class.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_120: I never called back. Too busy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_122: Would give my right hand to hear her voice one more time.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_124: Would've kissed Sarah Miller if I hadn't chickened out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_125: Never saw her after graduation. Never knew what happened.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_126: Sometimes I wonder. Sarah, if you're out there. Sorry.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_127: Broke down on I-64 west, back in '87.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_128: Strange trucker stopped. Fixed my alternator in twenty minutes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_13: Marcus was the smart one. Katie couldn't sit still.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_130: Said, 'Just pay it forward when you can.'
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_131: I've been trying to. Not always successful.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_132: Old man used to come to the diner every morning at 6 AM.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_133: Same order. Coffee, black. Toast, dry.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_135: I still leave one seat at the counter open in my head.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_136: Neighbor's dog escaped one thunderstorm night.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_138: Found her scared under my porch.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_139: Little terrier named Muffin. Slept in my bed for three days after.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_14: I wonder if any of them made it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_141: Third grade. Kid gave me half his sandwich.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_142: I'd forgotten my lunch. Was pretending I wasn't hungry.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_143: His name was Robert. Never forgot that sandwich.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_147: This apocalypse? Kind of funny. Feels familiar.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_148: Maybe that's why I've lasted this long.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_149: First time I killed someone in this new world?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_15: I hope Marcus is out there being smart somewhere.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_150: Guy came at me with a machete over a can of beans.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_153: Been eating beans ever since. Every one tastes like guilt.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_154: Grew up Baptist. Church every Sunday.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_155: Broke my faith the first month.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_156: Watched a kid get bit and turn. Prayed. Nothing happened.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_157: God went quiet. Or He was never speaking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_158: Sometimes I still pray anyway. Habit, I guess.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_159: Saw a Chevelle SS parked on Preston Highway last week.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_16: Ten years behind the bar at Kaiju on Baxter.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_160: Cherry red. Been there a year, judging by the rust.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_161: Grand dad had one just like it in '73.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_162: Bought me my first ice cream cone in that car.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_163: Wish I could take it home. Just to sit in it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_164: Yellow Camaro at the overpass by Louisville Slugger Field.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_167: Wonder if they got out. Wonder if they went to a game there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_169: Ford F-250 in a driveway on Bardstown Road.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_225: Some things you only know in hindsight.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_227: One drunk night with a coworker.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_228: Never told her. Guilt ate at me for two years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_229: She died before I could confess.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_230: Sometimes I wonder if she knew and forgave me.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_233: Never finished his Beethoven sonata with me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_234: Wonder if he's still out there. Playing something.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_236: Bought pizza with my own money after every game.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_243: Buried her under the maple tree three years ago.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_244: Cat named Miles. Fat orange tabby.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_246: Woke me up with a paw on the face when he wanted breakfast.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_248: Wonder if he's alive. Wonder if he still thinks about me.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_256: Ordered every waffle on the menu.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_259: Rolled out on the same wooden board.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_260: Board was older than my mother.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_269: Someone left flowers on the steps.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_273: Swings still moving in the breeze.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_275: Sat on a swing for an hour. Felt like a kid again.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_276: Louisville Free Public Library. Fourth and York.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_279: Picked up one and read for an hour on the steps.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_28: Buy a book at Half-Price on my way home.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_280: Small dignity in reading amid ruins.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_281: My best friend from high school moved to Nashville.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_282: Kept meaning to call. Every year.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_283: Twenty years went by without a call.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_284: He's probably dead now. Or worse.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_285: I let time steal that friendship. My fault.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_289: Never fully apologized. Just moved on.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_29: Simple ritual. Never realized how good I had it.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_291: I dream I wake up in my own bed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_294: Every morning, I open my eyes hoping.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_296: Dream I'm fishing on the Ohio again.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_298: Grandpa beside me, not saying a word.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_299: Peace like that used to be free.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_3: Made trucks that took people home for Sunday dinner.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_30: Cave Hill Cemetery. That was my quiet place.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_301: Kept a radio going for six months after.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_304: One time - swear to God - I heard a woman singing 'Amazing Grace.'
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_305: Never heard her again. But I know she was real.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_308: First tomato I picked, I cried.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_310: Ran into a group last month.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_311: Family with three kids. All alive.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_313: Hadn't heard kids laugh in six months.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_314: That night I slept for eight straight hours. First time.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_317: Sat and listened for twenty minutes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_318: Nature doesn't care. And that's oddly comforting.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_319: Found a vending machine still running last week.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_320: Off some solar setup, I think.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_327: Whole city laid out silent below me.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_33: Wonder if the graves are still peaceful.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_343: Prayed every night as a kid.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_346: Sometimes I still pray. But it's more like... talking to the wall.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_76: Best week of the year for the whole town.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_9: But you know what? I miss it.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_NPC_STORY_94: Grandma Ruby was mama and daddy both.

IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_coffee_ext_3: Any coffee is good coffee now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_coffee_ext_4: Waffle House pot at 4 AM. Sacred.
