IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_day_one_re_5: Just got off shift at St. Joseph's. Never made it home.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_day_one_re_6: Church. Preacher was mid-sermon. Someone busted through the doors.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_day_one_re_7: Kids' birthday party. All the kids screaming. Not for cake.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_derby_re_1: Twin Spires. Mint julep. Wide-brimmed hats. Kentucky dream.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_derby_re_3: Churchill Downs. My mama's church. She'd say.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_derby_re_4: Trainers, jockeys, owners... all gone probably.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_derby_re_5: Won 40 bucks in '86. Blew it on beer that night.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_dreams_ext_1: First real steak in three weeks. Ribeye. Medium rare.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_dreams_ext_2: Take a bath. Then another bath.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_dreams_ext_3: See if the Ohio River still flows.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_dreams_ext_4: Louisville Slugger Museum. See the bats.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_dreams_ext_5: Sit on my porch. Any porch.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_family_ext_1: Wife lives in my head now. She's got opinions.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_family_ext_2: Two kids. Twin girls. Age 9. God, I hope.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_family_ext_4: Grew up an only child. Now I know why.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_family_ext_5: Grandma passed in '89. My last real family.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_first_zombie_re_1: Neighbor. Mrs. Henderson. Nicest lady. Then she wasn't.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_first_zombie_re_2: My coworker at the store. Chased me through aisle six.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_first_zombie_re_3: Guy at the gas station. Broke my brain.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_first_zombie_re_4: Don't wanna talk about it. Not today.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_food_dreams_re_2: Ribeye at Longhorn. Medium rare. Buttered mushrooms.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_food_dreams_re_4: Wife's fried chicken. She'd whip that up in an hour.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_food_dreams_re_5: Whole rack of ribs. Feast Bar-B-Q style.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_food_dreams_re_6: Bourbon. Just a bottle. Drink it slow.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_food_memory_re_1: Wife's Kentucky burgoo. Best in the state.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_food_memory_re_2: Cracker Barrel on I-65 south. Comfort food.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_food_memory_re_3: Bristol Bar and Grille. Fancy for us.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_food_memory_re_4: Mom's biscuits and gravy. Nothing else compares.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_food_memory_re_5: Kentucky Fried Chicken original recipe. Legend.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_food_memory_re_6: Best Burger at Sports Grille off Preston. RIP.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_gardening_re_1: Tomatoes and basil on the balcony. Now I need real farming.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_gardening_re_2: Grandma's garden in Bardstown. Big enough to feed the county.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_gardening_re_3: Backyard chickens. City ordinance let us have 4. Miss them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_gardening_re_4: Kentucky soil grows anything if you're patient.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_gardening_re_5: Watermelons the size of my head. Bardstown summer.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_god_re_1: Baptist boy here. Yes. And confused.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_god_re_2: Been to St. James too many times to give up now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_god_re_5: If he's watching, he's got explaining to do.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_god_re_6: Kentucky Bible Belt. We were raised for this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_goodbye_wanted_re_1: My dog Buddy. He was old. Hope he didn't suffer.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_goodbye_wanted_re_2: My high school sweetheart. Never told her how I felt.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_goodbye_wanted_re_3: The mailman. Sounds dumb. He was always kind.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_goodbye_wanted_re_4: My mom. Just one more hug.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_goodbye_wanted_re_5: My unborn baby. Never even chose a name.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_goodbye_wanted_re_6: The neighbor lady who watched my kids. She was family too.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_guns_ammo_re_2: Bourbon County. Every truck's got a gun rack.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_guns_ammo_re_3: Grew up shooting deer on Grandpa's farm.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_hobbies_re_1: Fishing. Ohio River. Even the polluted stretches.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_hobbies_re_2: Bowling league at Fern Terrace Lanes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_hobbies_re_5: Playing pool at Pete's Sports Bar.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_hometown_ext_2: St. Matthews. Louisville suburb. Real quiet.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_hometown_ext_5: Not from Kentucky. Cincinnati. But lived here 20 years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_hometown_ext_6: Frankfort. Yes, our capital. Nobody knows.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_job_stress_re_1: Ha! I hated Kroger. Now I miss Kroger.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_job_stress_re_2: Nine to five would be a dream now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_job_stress_re_4: Missed one paycheck at Ford. Whole world ended after.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_job_stress_re_5: Retired the day before it hit. Karma? Luck?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kentucky_ext_1: Kentucky Wildcats forever. Rupp Arena is holy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kentucky_ext_2: U of L Cards. Best college city.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kentucky_ext_3: Sports are done. But loyalty remains.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kids_dreams_re_1: Astronaut. Six years old, big dreams.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kids_dreams_re_2: Baseball player. Cincinnati Reds. Practiced every day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kids_dreams_re_3: Veterinarian. She loved every animal she ever saw.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kids_dreams_re_5: Rock star. Guitar was bigger than him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kids_dreams_re_6: Farmer. Wanted to inherit grandpa's tobacco land.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kids_re_1: Two boys. 7 and 10. Left them with grandma. Hope she made it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kids_re_2: Daughter. She'd be 15 now. Or forever 15.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kids_re_3: Never had any. Now I never will.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kids_re_4: Three. Twins are the youngest. Nightmare bedtimes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_kids_re_5: One. My son. He's out there somewhere. I know it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_meal_re_1: My grandma's fried chicken. Hot Brown from the Brown Hotel. Bourbon.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_meal_re_2: Cheeseburger from Dairy Queen. Simple pleasures.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_meal_re_4: Real Coca-Cola. In the glass bottle. Just cold as ice.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_meal_re_5: KFC drumstick and mashed potatoes. Kentucky classic.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_meal_re_6: Slice of Derby Pie. Sweet tea. Never took it for granted.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_normal_day_re_1: Sunday cookout. Whole family. Kids played tag until dark.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_normal_day_re_2: Movie night. We watched Groundhog Day. Ironic now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_normal_day_re_3: Fishing at Kentucky Lake. Just me and dad. Perfect quiet.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_normal_day_re_4: First day of teaching. New year. New students. Full of hope.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_normal_day_re_5: Wedding anniversary. Steak dinner. Slow dance in the kitchen.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_last_normal_day_re_6: My baby's baptism. Whole family came out. Miss those faces.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_lost_child_re_1: Two. Boy and a girl. Haven't seen them since day one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_lost_child_re_2: Little girl. Six years old. I couldn't get to her school in time.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_lost_child_re_3: Son had just started kindergarten. Loved his backpack more than anything.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_lost_child_re_4: Twins. Nine years old. I keep their photo in my pocket.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_lost_child_re_5: Daughter was in college. Louisville. Never heard from her again.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_lost_child_re_6: No. Was trying. Almost happened. Then this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_days_re_1: Whitney's 'I Will Always Love You.' Made me cry then. Cries me more now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_days_re_2: 'Achy Breaky Heart.' God, we all hated that song. Miss it now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_days_re_3: Garth Brooks. 'The Dance.' Perfect timing for the world.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_days_re_4: Was on the classical station. Some sad piece. Never learned the name.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_days_re_5: Nirvana. 'Heart-Shaped Box.' In Utero had just dropped.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_days_re_6: Kentucky bluegrass. WKYU-FM. Grandpa's kind of music.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_ext_1: Somebody plays fiddle up in the West Point safehouse. Beautiful.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_ext_2: MTV's Real World was my show. Judge me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_ext_3: Grunge died with the world. Mourn accordingly.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_pref_re_2: Country. Real country. Not the pop crap.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_pref_re_3: Rock and roll. Rolling Stones era.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_music_pref_re_6: MTV played everything. I loved all of it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_neighbor_pre_re_1: Old lady across the hall knew everything. Miss her gossip.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_neighbor_pre_re_2: Guy next door was a jerk. Zombie bit him. Fair.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_neighbor_pre_re_4: Never met mine. Big regret now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_neighborhood_re_1: Bardstown Road apartment. Rent was killing me. Now nothing kills me but zombies.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_neighborhood_re_2: PRP. Three-bedroom split-level. Kids grew up there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_neighborhood_re_3: St. Matthews. Little brick house. Good neighbors.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_neighborhood_re_4: Highlands. Bougie but I loved it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_neighborhood_re_6: Cherokee Triangle. Historic. Expensive. Worth every penny.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_news_re_2: Rumor says Bardstown had a survivor group. Maybe.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_news_re_3: West Point Marina's supposed to be safe. Rumor.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_news_re_4: Don't listen to rumors. Kills you faster than zombies.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_news_re_5: Only news I need is 'no zombies today'.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_night_ext_2: Sleep during day. Watch at night. Kentucky doctrine.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_night_ext_3: Cardinal calls at dawn. Only good sound left.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_past_life_ext_1: Manager at K-Mart on Dixie Highway. RIP retail.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_past_life_ext_10: Truck driver. Louisville to Nashville and back. Twice a week.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_past_life_ext_4: Postal worker. Zone code 40216. Every day, same route.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_past_life_ext_5: Taught karate at Sanford Kelsey Dojo.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_past_life_ext_6: Cardinals season ticket holder. Retired at 43. Was a good run.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_past_life_ext_7: Nurse at Baptist East. Third shift.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_past_life_ext_8: Custodian at U of L. Overnight. Great gig.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_past_life_ext_9: Grocery clerk at Winn-Dixie. Long shifts.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_prayer_re_2: Not really. But I whisper hopes sometimes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_prayer_re_4: God got quiet after everything. But I still try.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_radio_re_1: WFPK. Louisville alt. Still hear static sometimes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_radio_re_2: Grandma's crank radio. Old but works.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_radio_re_4: Sirius satellite would help. If satellites still work.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_regret_re_2: Never proposed. She waited. Now she's gone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_regret_re_3: Argued with my dad the last time we talked. About politics.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_regret_re_4: Skipped my kid's game to work overtime. That one haunts me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_regret_re_5: Never told my brother I loved him. Not out loud.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_regret_re_6: Stayed at that dead-end job too long. Wasted years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_regrets_re_2: Should've kissed her at senior prom.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_regrets_re_4: Should've bought that house on Bardstown Road.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_regrets_re_5: Should've moved to Nashville. Should've stayed in Kentucky.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_regrets_re_6: Should've told her I loved her. Last chance was Tuesday.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_relationship_re_1: Wife of 12 years. Gone. Not saying how.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_relationship_re_2: Girlfriend when it hit. Waited three days at the meetup. She didn't come.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_relationship_re_3: Divorced twice. Fitting time for it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_relationship_re_4: Single. Best decision I made this year.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_relationship_re_5: Married my high school sweetheart. Best day of my life.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_relationship_re_6: Was engaged when it started. Ring's still on my finger.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_scary_moments_re_1: Almost caught by three at once. Louisville Slugger saved me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_scary_moments_re_2: Slipped in blood. Fell on my ass. Zombie feet from me. Nightmare.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_scary_moments_re_3: Locked myself in a fridge for 6 hours. Zombie couldn't reach.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_scary_moments_re_4: Ambush by hostile survivors. Never trusted anyone since.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_scary_moments_re_5: Zombie horde at the White Castle on Preston. Lost my buddy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_scavenging_re_1: Case of canned peaches at a Muldraugh farmhouse. Peach paradise.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_scavenging_re_2: Winchester 30-30 with 300 rounds. Grandpa Christmas gift level.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_scavenging_re_3: Antibiotics jackpot at Norton. Whole shelf untouched.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_scavenging_re_4: Working generator plus fuel. Camping kit.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_scavenging_re_5: Bourbon stash under a farmhouse floor. Kentucky miracle.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_simple_joys_re_7: My old dog waiting at the door.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_simple_joys_re_9: The Sunday paper. Even the ads.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_small_things_re_1: Ice. Just... ice cubes. Cold drink on a hot day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_small_things_re_4: Traffic light turning green just as I approached.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_small_things_re_5: The click of a lightbulb switching on.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_small_things_re_6: Junk mail. Getting anything. Even bills.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_smoking_ext_1: Take two. But you owe me a beer.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_smoking_ext_2: Down to my last pack. Sorry.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_smoking_ext_4: Rolled these myself. Better than store-bought.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_smoking_ext_5: Grandpa left me a whole carton. Bless him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_survival_tips_re_1: Water first. Always. Kentucky heat kills.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_survival_tips_re_4: Stranger fights are worse than zombie fights.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_survival_tips_re_5: Trust nobody at first. Trust harder after.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_survival_tips_re_6: Stock up before winter. Kentucky winters are cold.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_the_boss_ext_1: Better than any manager I had at Kroger.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_the_boss_ext_2: Kentucky-tough. That's what I look for.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_the_boss_ext_3: Only person I trust more than the dog. And there's no dog.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_the_boss_ext_4: Reminds me of my drill instructor. Except better.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_weapon_check_ext_1: Louisville Slugger and a hunting knife. Kentucky basics.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_weapon_check_ext_3: Never bothered to zero this scope. Regretting it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_weather_extra_re_1: Four seasons in one day. Kentucky classic.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_weather_extra_re_2: Tornado warnings kept my mom's radio on 24/7.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_weather_extra_re_3: Snow, sun, rain, hail. Sometimes in one afternoon.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_weather_extra_re_4: The Weather Channel would've had a field day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_what_kept_us_re_1: Chance my kids might still be alive. Slim, but there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_what_kept_us_re_2: Guilt. I owe it to the ones who died to keep breathing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_what_kept_us_re_4: Spite. Universe wants me dead. I'm not obliging.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_what_kept_us_re_5: Faith. God's got a reason. I just don't see it yet.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_PC_what_kept_us_re_6: Fear of not knowing. Better to try than give up.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_READING_1: Been meaning to get back to reading.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_READING_2: Bookstores don't exist anymore. So I read what I find.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_READING_3: Louisville library had the best collection.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_READING_6: Reading in the apocalypse. Peak civilization.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_READING_7: This author was a Louisville native. Small world.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_READING_8: Wife loved reading. Miss her opinions on plot.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_RECRUITED_2: I owe you one. Won't forget.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_RECRUITED_3: Been alone too long. Thanks for taking me in.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_RECRUITED_6: You saved me. I got your back.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_RECRUITED_8: Hope you know what you're doing. I don't.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_RECRUITED_9: One team, one fight. That's what my drill sergeant said.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_REVIVED_5: Back from the dead. Almost literally.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_REVIVED_7: One more life used up. Careful with mine.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_11: Great. Another one. Just what I needed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_12: Oh look. A friend. How nice.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_14: Fresh from the corner of Preston and dying.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_17: Because clearly the day needed more.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_23: Oh no. Oh no no no.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_25: There's more of them, I can feel it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_3: Come on, ugly. Say hi to the Slugger.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_31: Just one? Give me a minute.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_32: Zombie. Great start to the day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_38: Say hi to my little friend. It's a bat.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_4: That's my third today. Keep 'em coming.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_40: Y'all keep spawning. I'll keep swinging.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_42: Bring it, corpse. Bring your friends.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_5: Been waiting all day for a fight.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_51: I've killed cans of Ale-8 more menacing than you.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_54: Get me a Louisville Slugger and a beer, will you?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_59: Preston and Main, welcome to Kentucky.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_60: This ain't Nashville. We don't dance here.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_65: Ekron farmboys are tougher than this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_67: Sit down, corpse. You're not on the guest list.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_7: I've killed uglier at 4th Street Live.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_70: Kentucky Derby, but for zombies. Not as fun.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_71: Louisville skyline used to shine. Now this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_72: One down, forty thousand to go.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_73: Ohio Valley cleanup crew, at your service.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SEE_ZOMBIE_8: Been dying to break in this weapon.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SMOKING_1: First smoke of the day. Best one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SMOKING_2: Killed my father. Killing me. Family tradition.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SMOKING_5: Wife made me quit. Then this happened. Now what.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SMOKING_6: Doctor said 'quit or die'. Turns out I could do both.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_10: So I rode. And I did things.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_100: Not proud of that. Not proud.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_102: Made whiskey older than most of these kids we've killed.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_103: Now the barrels are burned. The rickhouses looted.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_105: I want to make something good again. Please.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_106: My husband hit me for twelve years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_107: First time I ever felt free was when he turned.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_108: Then the gang took his place.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_109: Turns out cruelty just finds a new face.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_11: Please just... let me go somewhere quiet to die.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_110: I'm done with cruelty. Both giving and taking.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_111: Slept under the Sixth Street bridge for two years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_112: Then the world got worse than my worst day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_113: Ironic - I was almost prepared for it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_114: Not for the killing though. Never that.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_115: Let me go crawl back under a bridge somewhere.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_117: Watched patients turn on my table.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_118: Called for help that never came.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_119: Took the epi kit and ran.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_12: St. James Catholic on Bardstown Road. That was my church.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_120: Wish I'd stayed and helped them pass in peace.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_122: Thought my badge-days were behind me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_123: The gang made me their enforcer. Wore that star again.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_125: Time to put it down for good.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_128: Turns out war just changes uniforms.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_129: Same fear in the eyes. Same crying.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_13: Father Mickey baptized me. My kids too.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_130: I don't want to be a soldier anymore. Not here.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_132: I held Communion the day it started.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_133: Watched the Body of Christ turn to the body of horror.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_134: Faith left me somewhere between the hospital and here.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_135: I don't ask forgiveness anymore. Just mercy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_136: Small farm outside Bardstown. Sixteen acres.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_138: Strangers took my land in December.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_139: Made me join them or die.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_14: I sold his crucifix for a can of beans last month.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_141: Piano lessons in Frankfort. Twenty years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_142: My last student was named Katie. Nine years old.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_143: Her lesson was 4 PM the day it hit.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_145: I still leave the piano open. Just in case.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_147: Just a lot of bad days that led here.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_148: You want a reason? I don't have one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_15: God's not watching. If He is, He's disgusted.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_150: Whatever you're gonna do... do it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_152: My boys turned on me last week.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_153: Left me for the dead over a case of beer.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_154: Now here I am. Meeting my end anyway.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_155: Kinda funny, if you think about it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_157: She's still alive back at our camp.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_158: I steal medicine for her. That's why I ride.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_159: If you kill me, she dies alone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_16: Please... a bullet is more than I deserve.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_161: I was on WFPK, Louisville alt.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_163: Broadcasted for two weeks after it started.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_164: Then the transmitter died and my voice with it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_166: Divorce papers came the day it hit.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_168: Ironic - she died in the driveway signing them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_169: I burned the papers. Kept the ring.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_17: They kept me in a basement for 3 weeks.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_170: Ring's the only thing I own now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_172: First hour of the outbreak we ran twenty calls.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_173: By hour six, we were the ones being called on.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_175: I saved lives once. Let me save one more - mine.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_176: Kaiju bar on Baxter Ave. Ten years behind that counter.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_178: Poured drinks for cops and criminals both.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_179: Turns out criminals and I ain't so different.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_180: Last drink I want is water. Please.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_181: I'm nineteen. Won't ever be twenty.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_182: The gang recruited me from Fern Creek at seventeen.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_183: I don't remember life before them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_184: Never had a girlfriend. Never went to prom.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_185: Just let me go somewhere and be a kid for a minute.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_187: Hands know how to cut. Turns out that's a bad thing to know.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_188: The gang used my skills for... other things.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_189: I've cleaned my hands a hundred times. Still not clean.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_19: Made me watch what they did to the others.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_190: Blood doesn't wash off, does it?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_191: I trained horses at Churchill Downs.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_192: Watched a full field go feral the week after.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_193: Had to shoot my favorite mare, Belle.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_194: Never got over that. She was mine for twelve years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_195: Kentucky Derby without horses. World isn't Kentucky anymore.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_196: Adopted at three, from foster care.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_197: My parents were the best people I ever knew.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_198: Died six months into this. Wouldn't take my ration.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_2: My wife and daughter were in Louisville when it started.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_20: By the time I got the chain off, I was... this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_200: I've made them ashamed. I'll stop.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_202: Ran out of insulin two months ago.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_204: The gang gives me sugar in exchange for... work.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_205: Kill me clean. Please. Better than the slow way.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_206: Wedding photographer. Louisville Bride magazine cover once.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_207: Took photos of the outbreak day. Documented it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_208: The memory card's in my pocket right now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_209: If you kill me, take it. Show someone. Show anyone.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_211: Buried my boyfriend under an oak tree in Cave Hill.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_212: Marked it with his lucky Cardinals hat.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_213: The gang made me leave. Made me ride.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_214: I want to go back and lie next to him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_215: That's all. Just let me lie beside him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_217: Every time I close my eyes, I see them.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_218: The people I've hurt. The faces.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_219: Sleep won't have me. So I stopped trying.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_22: I had a black lab. Named her Butter.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_220: Maybe death will be the sleep I need.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_221: Fled Saigon in '75. Ten years old.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_223: Now I'm the last of them. Second apocalypse takes what the first didn't.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_224: I've seen enough. I've done enough.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_225: In my language: đủ rồi. Enough.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_227: Designed the machines that made the bats.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_228: Now I use those bats on people. Poetry.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_229: I'd unmake it all if I could.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_23: Kept her alive for weeks eating half my rations.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_231: I was ten when my dad shot my mom.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_232: That was 1976. I turned out okay. Mostly.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_233: Then this happened. I turned out into this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_234: Bad wiring runs deep, I guess.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_235: Not blaming him. Not blaming the world. Just... explaining.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_236: Grandma Ruby raised me in a trailer in West Point.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_238: Died in her sleep, right before all this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_239: Only mercy I've seen in years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_24: The gang shot her when I brought her home.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_240: If there's a heaven, she's fussing at me. Loud.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_241: Scholarship to U of L. Football.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_242: Torn ACL freshman year. Full ride pulled.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_243: Never recovered. Not the knee. Not me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_244: Been angry ever since. Now the anger's out.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_246: I killed a boy last week.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_247: He was maybe fifteen. Had a can of soup.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_249: I still have half a can left in my pocket.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_25: Said dogs were extra mouths. Extra noise.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_253: None of them showed up on day three.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_254: I still have my roll book.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_255: I read their names sometimes. That's all they get from me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_257: PTSD papers piled up like snowflakes.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_258: VA gave me pills. Pills made it worse.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_259: The apocalypse actually made it better. Weird.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_26: Never cried before that. Cried like a kid.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_260: Then I fell in with these people. Made it worse again.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_261: My father was a mean drunk.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_262: Mom left him when I was 8. He found us anyway.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_263: Shot her at Kroger on Preston Highway. 1987.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_264: I made a promise to never be him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_265: I broke that promise last month. I'm sorry.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_266: I was a sculptor. Ceramics, mostly.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_267: Sold pieces at Highlands art fair every fall.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_268: Hands were meant for clay, not violence.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_269: Feel these hands? Muscle memory of shaping things.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_271: Left my boyfriend at the Louisville Zoo.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_272: He was bit. Told me to run.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_275: Would you tell him I'm sorry? If you ever pass the zoo?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_276: Had a kid at 16. Named him Wyatt.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_277: Lost custody. Lost my place. Lost me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_278: Living in a shelter when it started.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_279: Wyatt's out there somewhere with his adopted family.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_28: Watched my precinct fall in one afternoon.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_280: Hoping the family kept him safer than I could.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_281: Tried to end it in '92. Bottle of pills.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_282: Somebody found me. I resented them for years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_283: Now I wonder if they're still out there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_284: Wonder if they'd forgive me for wasting the second chance.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_285: Doesn't matter. Third chance is here.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_286: Louisville Bats minor league. Third baseman.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_287: Had a good year in '90. Almost got called up.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_288: Torn rotator cuff killed the dream.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_289: Killed the me that had dreams.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_29: Killed my partner myself. He'd turned.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_290: This version of me? Been dead since '91.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_291: The Roadblock crew kept me as their pack mule.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_293: Sores under my armor. Rot on my back.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_294: Broke free two weeks ago. Should've kept running.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_295: Instead I stayed to steal from you. I'm the worst kind.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_296: Last Christmas I had a tree. Popcorn strings.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_297: Kids opened presents. Wife made bourbon balls.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_298: Best day of my life. Didn't know it then.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_299: Now every day is the day I don't have.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_3: I never got to them. Never even found their bodies.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_30: Been hunting people ever since. Told myself they were the enemy.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_300: Just... don't take today from me too.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_302: Fed racetrack workers every morning at 5 AM.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_303: Best waffles in Kentucky, they said.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_304: Kitchen went dark. So did I.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_305: Miss the smell of butter and syrup.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_306: My little sister Chelsea is out there.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_307: Left me a note before I lost the apartment.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_31: They weren't. Just scared like me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_310: You see a brown-eyed girl with a butterfly tattoo? Tell her I tried.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_312: Nobody warned him what was coming.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_313: He didn't hear them. Didn't hear me screaming.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_314: Everything came back to signs after that.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_315: I don't speak much anymore. Not out loud.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_316: Grandpa gave me his watch on my 18th birthday.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_317: 1943, U.S. Army. Kept perfect time for 80 years.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_318: I traded it for a can of chili last month.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_319: Broke my grandpa's trust for chili.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_32: My boy Danny. He'd be 8 now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_321: Fell in love with a boy in the crew.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_323: The leader shot him last week. Suspected me of loving him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_325: Rather join Marcus than keep running.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_326: I miscarried three days before the outbreak.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_328: The world ended before I finished grieving.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_329: Never got to grieve her. Just the world.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_33: Grandma took him to Frankfort right before it hit.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_330: Let me sit down. Let me finally cry for Grace.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_331: Took a wrong turn on I-64 west, back on day one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_332: Ended up in Lexington instead of home in Louisville.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_334: Fell in with wrong people. Ate wrong things.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_336: Grew up in Wilmington, North Carolina.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_337: Moved to Kentucky for a job in '95.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_338: Never made it back to the ocean.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_339: That's the one thing I want.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_34: I don't know if they made it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_340: Bury me somewhere I can hear water.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_342: Been alive for a lot of ends of the world. This is my last one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_343: Riding with these young ones kept me warm at night.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_346: You seem kinder than the others.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_347: I don't have a story worth telling.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_348: I've hurt people. I know that.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_349: If I could unmake it, I would.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_35: Every survivor I meet, I ask.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_350: Show me the mercy the world stopped showing.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_36: You didn't happen to see a boy with red hair, did you?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_37: Started with pills after the accident.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_39: When the world ended, I stopped needing dope.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_4: The gang took me in when I was starving.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_40: Turns out I still needed the anger.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_41: I need help. I'll come with you. Please.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_43: Thought I was done with all this.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_44: Guess Uncle Sam trained me too well.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_45: I hurt people who didn't deserve it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_46: There's no fixing that. But I can stop.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_47: My mama raised me right. Church every Sunday.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_48: She turned in the driveway. I was making breakfast.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_49: I couldn't do it. I ran.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_5: Told me family means nothing anymore.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_50: Been running from something ever since.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_52: Danny was my best friend since third grade.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_53: When the crew said only one of us could stay, we drew straws.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_54: He drew short. I could have switched. I didn't.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_55: They made me pull the trigger.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_56: Every day since, I hear him.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_58: Small press in Louisville. Nobody read it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_59: Not much rhyme in what I do now.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_6: They lied. God, how they lied.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_60: Just... let me sit here a while.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_61: Let me remember what words felt like.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_62: My daddy preached at Southeast Christian.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_63: Told me hell was for the wicked.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_64: Turns out heaven's just as empty as hell.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_68: Mrs. Patterson - I mean, that was me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_69: Twenty-two kids in my last class.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_70: I don't know if any of them made it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_71: Sometimes I hope none of them did.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_73: My whole apartment building was screaming.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_74: I climbed out my third-floor window and ran.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_76: I hope you're stronger than I was.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_77: Played jazz at the Seelbach Hotel bar.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_78: Wife'd sing while I played piano.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_79: She died at the hospital giving birth to twins.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_8: The Highlands crew found me eating rats behind Kroger.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_80: Twins died too. Same week the world ended.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_81: I haven't played a note since.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_82: I was in KSP when it happened.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_84: The guards left us to starve. Or worse.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_85: I busted out with a boy named Zeke.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_86: Zeke ate a bullet three days in. I wish I had.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_87: Stage 3 pancreatic. Six months, they said.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_89: The zombies don't scare me. Death doesn't scare me.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_9: Said if I didn't ride with them, they'd feed me to the dead.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_90: What scares me is I don't have anyone to say goodbye to.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_91: You listening? That counts for something.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_92: My little girl Rose was allergic to peanuts.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_93: I forgot her EpiPen at Kroger.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_94: By the time I got back... it was chaos.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_96: Twenty-two years at the Ford Truck Plant.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_98: Made the trucks that took people to safety.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_SUR_STORY_99: Then I stole one to run people down.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_DANCE_1: What in the world is he doing?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_DANCE_11: I'm too old for this. He isn't.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_DANCE_12: Somebody put music on for real.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_DANCE_13: First good thing I've seen all week.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_DANCE_15: Dance like nobody's watching. Except we are.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_DANCE_3: Save some for the rest of us.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_DANCE_5: Reminds me of my cousin at every wedding.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_DANCE_7: Zombies out there and he's dancing. I love it.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_DANCE_8: Actually cheering me up a bit.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_DANCE_9: Are we... having fun? Is that allowed?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_1: Does he think he's Kurt Cobain?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_10: Bit loud. But hey, morale, right?
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_11: That amp's louder than my ex-wife on Sundays.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_12: Deliverance vibes. Not the good kind.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_13: That's a Kentucky boy if I ever saw one.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_14: Actually kinda hopeful. Which is weird.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_17: Didn't know we had a concert violinist among us.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_18: Reminds me of the Louisville Orchestra.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_19: That's beautiful. Wish I could do that.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_2: Not bad. Not great. But not bad.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_21: Kenny G called. He wants his gig back.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_22: That's got some soul. Baxter Avenue soul.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_23: Jazz in the apocalypse. Why not.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_28: Reminds me of Derby parade day.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_3: Reminds me of coffeehouses off Bardstown Road.
IGUI_HDX_Speech_WITNESS_MUSIC_33: The 80s called. They want their instrument back.

IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillAiming_1: Control your breathing. Squeeze the trigger, don't pull it. And focus on the front sight — everything else blurs, and that's fine.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillAiming_2: Training. Muscle memory kicks in when your brain shuts down from fear. Dry fire every night if you can — repetition is everything.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillAiming_3: Panicking and shooting fast. You'll miss and waste ammo. Slow down, aim, and make the shot count. Ammo is survival.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_1: Always measure twice, cut once. And keep your tools sharp — a dull saw is dangerous and sloppy.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_2: Solid joints make solid structures. Learn to nail and screw properly and you can build almost anything.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillCarpentry_3: Double up the walls, brace the corners, and always build on a proper foundation. Shortcuts get people killed.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillCooking_1: You'd be surprised what you can do with canned goods and a fire. Season everything, and never waste fat — it adds flavor and calories.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillCooking_2: Smell it, look at it. If it smells off or has mold, toss it. When in doubt, cook it — heat kills most things.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillCooking_3: Stews. One pot, water, and whatever you find. Boil it long enough and almost anything becomes edible.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillElectrical_1: Generators are your best bet. Keep the fuel fresh, don't overload it, and run it away from where people sleep — carbon monoxide kills silently.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillElectrical_2: Never touch anything live. Always cut power first. Circuit breakers exist for a reason — if one trips repeatedly, something is wrong upstream.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillElectrical_3: Match wire gauges, secure all connections, and insulate everything. Bad insulation causes fires. Fires out here are a death sentence.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillFarming_1: Good soil, water, sunlight, and patience. Raised beds help — they drain better and keep pests away from the roots.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillFarming_2: Potatoes and beans. They grow fast, don't need much, and give you calories. Tomatoes too, if you have seeds.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillFarming_3: Rotate your crops and keep the area clean. Companion planting helps too — some plants keep bugs away from others naturally.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_1: Clean it immediately, always. Pressure stops bleeding. Without antibiotics, infection is what actually kills you — watch for redness and fever.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_2: Antiseptic and bandages. Everything else is secondary. A clean wound that's wrapped properly heals. A dirty one doesn't.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillFirstAid_3: Splint it — any straight, rigid material works. Tie it in place, immobilize the joint, don't let them walk on it. And pray.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillMechanics_1: Check your fluids first — oil, coolant, brake fluid. If it runs, listen for what sounds wrong. Engines talk if you let them.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillMechanics_2: Tire changes and battery swaps. After that, belts and filters. Simple stuff keeps a car alive longer than anything.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_A_SkillMechanics_3: Smoke, knocking, seized parts — those are signs it's gone. Otherwise, most things are fixable if you have time and parts.

IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_FightingForFo: Not having to fight for every meal.

IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_HatedAdmit: I hate to admit it, but yes... and now none of it matters.

IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_JokeSurprised: Ha! You're funnier than you look.

IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_LearnedShooti: I guess I learned to shoot... on the fly.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_LookWhereItLe: Yes... and look where it got me.

IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Story_Chicken: My neighbor kept chickens before all this. We all thought he was crazy. Now I'd do anything for a fresh egg.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Story_Concert: I was at a concert when the outbreak news came to everyone's phones. People just... kept dancing. Nobody believed it yet. I miss that kind of ignorance.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Story_Dog: I had a dog named Rex. Toughest little mutt you ever saw. He saved my life once... I hope he's still out there somewhere.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Story_Lost: I got lost hiking once. Three days alone in the woods. Thought I was done for. Funny how that feels like a warm-up now.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Story_Neighbo: There was this old woman on my street who always watched everyone from her porch. Turns out she was the one keeping track of everything. She probably knew it was coming before any of us.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Story_NightSh: I once locked myself inside my workplace on a night shift. Spent six hours trying to get out. Good training for what came next.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Story_RoadTri: Before all this, my car broke down in the middle of nowhere on a road trip. Spent two days fixing it with zip ties and prayers.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Survive: Future? My plan is to get through today.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Surviving: I've been better, but I'm surviving.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_TalkingDoesnt: Yes... but talking about it doesn't help.
IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Tired: I'm tired, but still on my feet.

IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_TrappedForDay: Being trapped in a store surrounded by zombies for 3 days.

IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_WhatsWrong: Excuse me? Look in a mirror sometime.

IGUI_StrangerDialog_Answer_Worried: I'm a bit worried about the future.

IGUI_ChuckAlertDonationMsg:
While I deeply enjoy modding, it requires significant time and energy, and I need to balance it with other responsibilities, particularly financial ones. To make it clear, I will continue to maintain, support, troubleshoot, and update my mods as I always have. However, these other priorities must come first.

This same situation can apply to almost all modders, and you may find support buttons for each respective mod listed here. These buttons are customizable and set by the mod-authors. If you’ve enjoyed any mod-author’s hardwork and dedication and would like to support it, consider doing so.

Personally, donations make it more feasible for me to dedicate time and effort to my projects. That said, there’s absolutely no pressure; please only donate if you’re comfortable and able. For me, your enjoyment of my mods is already a tremendous reward.

Thank you for your support and understanding!

IGUI_Instruments_Band: Band Play: Once all players are ready, have one member of your group hold down the 'X' key for a few seconds to start the song.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body: Group performances are a unique and engaging mechanic that lets players collaborate musically in-game. By forming a band with friends, you can play coordinated songs using different instruments to create a dynamic and immersive experience. Whether you're a vocalist or an instrumentalist, group performances add a layer of fun and creativity to the game, perfect for adding some harmony to the chaos of the apocalypse.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body2: <H1> Getting Started <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Instruments_Band_02.png><LINE><LINE><LEFT> 1. Level Up Your Music Skill <LINE><TEXT> To participate in group performances, you'll need at least Music Level 4, but it's worth leveling up further. Higher levels unlock more band songs, expanding your repertoire and improving your overall performance. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 2. Develop Instrument Affinity <LINE><TEXT> Each instrument requires a certain level of familiarity, gained by learning songs for that instrument. Aim for about 20 learned songs to unlock the Group Perform option. This may sound like a lot, but at higher Music Levels, it's an easy to reach threshold. <LINE> Exception: Singing doesn't require instrument affinity, only Music Skill progression. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 3. Choose Your Role <LINE><TEXT> Each part of a band performance is tied to a specific instrument or the microphone (for vocals). While a full band with multiple instruments offers the most depth, you can perform with as few as two players. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 4. Starting the Performance <LINE><TEXT> First enter the 'Waiting Phase' by selecting the song you want to play. When in this phase, characters will just hold their instruments as if about to play, thus giving other players time to prepare. Once everyone is in the waiting phase, one player must hold the X key for a few seconds to begin the song (it's recommended that only one player hold the key down). The performance will then start, with each player contributing their selected part. <H1><LINE><LEFT> 5. Fail-Proof Fun <LINE><TEXT> Group performances are designed to be fun and frustration-free. You can't fail a song due to low skill, so even beginners can join in without worry. However, keep in mind that panic (if your character isn’t desensitized) can still disrupt the performance.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body3: <H1> Tips for Success <LINE><IMAGECENTRE:media/ui/tutorial/Instruments_Band_03.png><LINE><LINE><H2><LEFT> - Build your repertoire early to have a wide selection of songs for group play. <LINE><LINE> - Coordinate with friends to assign roles and instruments before starting a session. <LINE><LINE> - Ensure your group is in a safe environment to avoid panic or interruptions during performances.
IGUI_Instruments_Band_Body4: <H2> Group performances bring a cooperative and lighthearted touch to the game, letting you and your friends create memorable moments while surviving the apocalypse!

IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailBig_Bummed: In addition, critical failures will always leave you feeling bummed for a while. It's inevitable after such a disaster.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailBig_Explosion: Ouch ouch ouch! Some parts exploded and almost took you with them! At least the workbench and some of your work seems to be intact, you think? Unfortunately the same can't be said for your eyebrows. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Project progress was greatly reduced and some materials were lost and will need to be replaced, the explosion might have also caused some injuries.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailBig_Reset: Enough! None of this is working! You kept arriving at roadblock after roadblock during the development of this project. You lost count of how many issues critical flaws you've ignored, but as grim as it looks there might still be a chance to save this project, albeit with a complete reset of the current phase. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Project phase duration was reset.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailBig_Ruined: Enough! None of this is working! You kept arriving at roadblock after roadblock during the development of this project. You lost count of how many issues and critical flaws you've ignored and now it feels like trying to save a sinking ship with cheap duct tape. This piece of junk can't be saved and it's best to just scrap whatever's left and forget this humiliating mistake. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Project was destroyed beyond repair.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailBig_Void: There are mental blocks and then there's this... There's something very wrong with you, it feels like your mind is floating in an endless void of pure nothingness. Try as you might you can't get out of this lull and you fear it might take a day or two fully recover. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Mental blocks prevent you from working and this time it will take much longer than usual to wear off.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailSmall_Bummed: For one reason or another, this issue was specially upsetting and now you just don't feel like continuing this project for a while.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailSmall_Material: You're not sure how it happened, but due to negligence or incompetence some materials got too damaged to be usable and will need to be replaced. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Some materials were lost.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailSmall_Progress: This just isn't working... You're not exactly sure where the issue is, but you have hit too many roadblocks with your current design to finally admit you need to take a few steps back and try another approach. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Project progress was reduced slightly.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailSmall_Skill: Everything seems to be going fine with this project, but you can't shake the feeling that there's something wrong. Perhaps... with you? <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> It seems some inventing experience was lost.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_FailSmall_Study: Despite your efforts, ideas just didn't seem to want to flow to you and the harder you tried the worse the mental block got. You probably need a few hours to cool down. <LINE><RGB:0.15,0.35,0.89> Mental blocks prevent you from working, but wears off after a few hours.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckBig_FocusGood: Everything became clear. The usual doubts, distractions and bad surprises are all lining up into useful ideas. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> No more bad events can happen for the rest of the project.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckBig_InstaFinish: That's it! Somehow everything finally came together much sooner than you expected. The last problems were solved in one inspired burst of unquestionable brilliance. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> The current phase was completed instantly.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckBig_ProgressBig: A major hurdle gave way all at once. What looked like a messy pile of compromises suddenly revealed itself as a workable design, which is either genius or extremely lucky. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> Project progress was greatly increased.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckBig_SkillBig: You've just experienced a rare moment where the difference between foolish tinkering and smart inventing became beautifully obvious. Unfortunately, now you know exactly how much of your previous work was foolish tinkering. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> A large amount of inventing experience was gained.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_Focus: For once, everything just seems to click. All distractions fade into the background as your sole focus is your project. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> No more events can happen in this phase, good or bad.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_GoodMood: This is going better than expected! For once the workbench doesn't feel like a personalized torture device with drawers. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> This small streak of success left you in a better mood.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_Lucky: You're not entirely sure why, but luck seems to be on your side for now. Best not to question it too much. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> The next bad event that occurs in this phase will be nullified.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_Lucky_trigge: You flinch as a cold feeling permeates your body and then vanishes just as quickly. Somehow you're certain that you just avoided disaster. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> A bad event was nullified by sheer luck.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_Progress: A few loose ideas finally snapped into place. The project still has some way to go, but one annoying problem solved itself much more cleanly than expected. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> Project progress was increased slightly.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_Skill: You stumbled into a small but useful realization while working on this project. It may not be groundbreaking, but it taught you something practical about the inventing process. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> Some inventing experience was gained.
IGUI_InvWorkbench_LuckSmall_SkillBoost: Suddenly learning new things has become much easier as you feel your mind more sharp and capable than before. You should probably take advantage of this boon. <LINE><RGB:1,1,1> Double inventing experience gain until you stop working.
