Sometimes other cars drive toward us. <LINE> <LINE> The radio plays quietly. The driver keeps both hands on the wheel and changes speed from time to time. <LINE> <LINE> We pass through a small town. Bicycles stand outside a shop, and several people wait for a bus near the stop. Then the houses fall behind and the fields begin again. <LINE> <LINE> The sun shines from the side, leaving reflections on the window. I open it slightly. Cool air and the smell of grass enter the car. <LINE> <LINE> The road bends gently. <LINE> <LINE> I keep looking outside, in no hurry, thinking only about how much farther we have to go.
IGUI_Dream199: I sit by the window of an airliner. A city burns below. Black smoke rises between the blocks, and tracer rounds flash in the clouds. <LINE> <LINE> Someone shouts that a missile is coming from the right. <LINE> <LINE> The impact tears open the fuselage behind the wing. <LINE> <LINE> White mist fills the cabin. Air rushes outside, dragging panels, luggage, and people with it. The belt cuts into my stomach. A metal fragment removes the face of the woman across the aisle. Blood and hair remain on the ceiling. <LINE> <LINE> Oxygen masks drop. I pull mine on, but no air comes through. <LINE> <LINE> The plane rolls sideways. Phones, teeth, a child’s shoe, and a severed hand with a wedding ring tumble down the aisle. <LINE> <LINE> The man beside me calls home. There is no signal. He speaks anyway: <LINE> <LINE> — I love you. Forgive me. <LINE> <LINE> Beyond the breach, the burning wing tears away. <LINE> <LINE> People pray, scream names, and claw at the seats. <LINE> <LINE> I should say goodbye too. <LINE> <LINE> But I remember an empty kitchen and an unlocked front door. <LINE> <LINE> The ground appears in the window. <LINE> <LINE> Very close. <LINE> <LINE> The light goes out.
IGUI_Dream200: I lie in a muddy crater with my face pressed into wet earth. The night trembles with artillery. Each nearby blast turns the sky white for a second, revealing scattered helmets, torn uniforms, and bodies buried in clay. <LINE> <LINE> Someone screams that we must advance. <LINE> <LINE> I rise and run with the others across the cratered field. Blood-stained water squelches under my boots. A man without a lower jaw falls on the left, trying to speak and choking. On the right, an armored vehicle burns, a charred arm hanging from the hatch. <LINE> <LINE> Ruined houses wait ahead. Machine-gun flashes fill the windows. The air is brick dust, smoke, and shrieking fragments. <LINE> <LINE> I run into an entrance hall. A young soldier sits on the stairs, clutching his stomach. Dark intestines spill between his fingers. <LINE> <LINE> — Tell my mother I wasn’t afraid. <LINE> <LINE> I cannot answer. <LINE> <LINE> The wall disappears. <LINE> <LINE> I hit the floor. My ears ring. <LINE> <LINE> I try to stand, but my legs are gone. <LINE> <LINE> Through the dust, unfamiliar boots appear in the doorway. <LINE> <LINE> Someone racks a weapon. <LINE> <LINE> I close my eyes and wait for the shot.
IGUI_Dream201: We move in a line through a shattered tree belt. Black earth is torn by craters and smells of wet clay, smoke, and something sweet and meaty. A helicopter passes low above us. No one looks up. We already know we have been seen. <LINE> <LINE> The commander screams to spread out, but it is too late. <LINE> <LINE> The first blast throws me into the mud. The second lands closer. Fragments cut branches, bark, and people apart. A man drops to his knees and grips his neck with both hands. Blood pulses between his fingers. He tries to breathe and only rasps. <LINE> <LINE> I crawl toward the roots of an uprooted tree. A medic’s bag lies nearby. Farther away is the man who carried it, missing everything below the waist. Intestines tangle with straps and bandages. <LINE> <LINE> The radio crackles with broken curses. Mortars pin us down. A machine gun fires from the smoke ahead. Behind us, someone shouts that we are being flanked. <LINE> <LINE> Beside me, a very young soldier with a soot-blackened face tightens a tourniquet around his thigh. His leg hangs by a strip of tissue. <LINE> <LINE> — Will they get us out? <LINE> <LINE> I cannot lie in time. <LINE> <LINE> The helicopter returns directly above us. <LINE> <LINE> A machine gun turns in the open doorway. <LINE> <LINE> I watch the gunner lean into the sights.
IGUI_Dream202: I run along the highway toward a military checkpoint. Sandbags, floodlights, barbed wire, and an armored personnel carrier wait ahead. Beyond the barricade, soldiers shout through bullhorns, but gunfire swallows their words. <LINE> <LINE> On the left, an overturned school bus burns. Someone inside is still beating on the glass. <LINE> <LINE> I reach the wire and wave my arms. A soldier in the tower sees me, raises his rifle, and screams: <LINE> <LINE> — Back! Get back! <LINE> <LINE> Rasping breaths and pounding feet are already closing behind me. <LINE> <LINE> Then everything happens at once. A mass of bodies surges out of the darkness. A machine gun opens up over my head. Bullets tear apart the people beside me. Meat and hot blood strike the sandbags. Someone catches his face in the wire and strips his cheek down to the bone. <LINE> <LINE> An explosion knocks over a floodlight. Its beam falls sideways. In the half-dark, the soldiers no longer care what they are shooting. <LINE> <LINE> A wounded man without either leg crawls toward me and reaches out. <LINE> <LINE> — Don’t leave me... <LINE> <LINE> The first dead man slams into my back. <LINE> <LINE> I fall directly onto the wire. <LINE> <LINE> The tower keeps firing.
IGUI_Dream203: I run along a highway jammed with cars. The road leads toward a military barricade, but the convoy has long stopped moving. Car doors hang open. Bags, blankets, and children’s toys lie on the seats. <LINE> <LINE> A helicopter appears above the trees. It flies low, almost touching the treetops. A gunner sits in the open doorway and points toward the soldiers ahead. <LINE> <LINE> The heavy machine gun at the checkpoint comes alive. <LINE> <LINE> Each shot strikes my chest like a hammer. Bullets punch straight through the cars. Windows burst and doors tear from their hinges. Wide, bloody gaps open in the mass of infected, but the dead keep coming, stepping over the torn bodies. <LINE> <LINE> A scream comes from a green station wagon. <LINE> <LINE> Inside, two children in blood-soaked clothes pin a man to the seat. One has its teeth buried in his cheek. The other tears open his belly with small hands and pulls out slick intestines. The man is still alive. He beats his head against the window and screams so high and long that I begin to vomit. <LINE> <LINE> The helicopter hovers above the road. Rotor wash scatters ash, paper, and hair. <LINE> <LINE> Soldiers shout for everyone to get down. <LINE> <LINE> No one has time. <LINE> <LINE> The machine gun swings along the convoy. <LINE> <LINE> Cars begin exploding one after another. <LINE> <LINE> The helicopter climbs sharply and leaves. <LINE> <LINE> I watch it go. <LINE> <LINE> Then I notice that the gunner in the open doorway is already dead—and still holding the weapon aimed directly at me.
IGUI_Dream204: I stand before the court in handcuffs. The room is stifling and smells of old paper, sweat, and cheap coffee. Photographs of a man I have never seen lie on the prosecution table. <LINE> <LINE> The prosecutor says my guilt has been proven. <LINE> <LINE> The witnesses point at me one after another. One gets the color of my clothes wrong. Another gives the wrong date. The third stares at the floor and repeats memorized words. <LINE> <LINE> I try to object, but my lawyer grabs my sleeve. <LINE> <LINE> — Keep quiet. You will only make it worse. <LINE> <LINE> A blurry videotape plays on a small television. No one could recognize the face in the dark shape. The jurors nod anyway. <LINE> <LINE> I turn toward my family. Their seats are empty. <LINE> <LINE> The judge shuffles papers without looking up. <LINE> <LINE> — Life imprisonment without the possibility of release. <LINE> <LINE> I scream that I did nothing. <LINE> <LINE> No one reacts. <LINE> <LINE> The bailiffs drag me through a side door. There is no courthouse corridor behind it, only a long prison block with cells on both sides. <LINE> <LINE> Prisoners stand silently behind the bars. <LINE> <LINE> An older version of me waits in every cell. <LINE> <LINE> One has gray hair. Another has no teeth. A third lies on a bunk and no longer breathes. <LINE> <LINE> They push me into the final cell. <LINE> <LINE> Words are scratched into the wall: <LINE> <LINE> “YOU WILL CONFESS. EVERYONE CONFESSES.” <LINE> <LINE> The door closes. <LINE> <LINE> Outside, the judge begins reading the sentence again.
IGUI_Dream205: I sit on a wooden dock beside a quiet lake. The water is almost still; only small circles spread around the float. <LINE> <LINE> Beside me stands an old metal tackle box. Inside are hooks, lead sinkers, a spool of line, and a folding knife. At my feet are a bucket of water and a jar of worms. <LINE> <LINE> The sun is just rising above the trees. The shore smells of damp earth, grass, and smoke from a distant fire. <LINE> <LINE> The float twitches slightly. <LINE> <LINE> I wait. <LINE> <LINE> It slips beneath the water. <LINE> <LINE> I set the hook and slowly reel in the line. The fish struggles, pulls to one side, then appears at the surface again. <LINE> <LINE> At last I lift out a small perch. It shines in the sunlight and calmly moves its gills. <LINE> <LINE> I remove the hook and lower it into the bucket. <LINE> <LINE> Then I bait the hook with another worm, cast the line, and listen to a bird calling somewhere in the reeds. <LINE> <LINE> I am in no hurry. <LINE> <LINE> The whole morning is still ahead.
IGUI_Dream206: I walk along a long road, needing the toilet more and more. <LINE> <LINE> At first it seems I can hold it. Then every step adds another weight to my stomach. I try to walk slowly, stay upright, and think about anything else. <LINE> <LINE> The first store is locked. <LINE> <LINE> At a gas station, a sign says: “RESTROOM FOR CUSTOMERS ONLY.” I buy a bottle of water, but the clerk says the key is missing. <LINE> <LINE> It gets much worse. <LINE> <LINE> I cross the road in tiny steps, clench my teeth, and look into a diner. The line stretches to the door. I ask for the restroom, but the woman behind the counter points to the end of the hall. <LINE> <LINE> The door is occupied. <LINE> <LINE> I knock. No one answers. <LINE> <LINE> I wait, shifting from foot to foot, and realize I cannot hold it any longer. <LINE> <LINE> The lock finally clicks. <LINE> <LINE> I slip inside, close the door, barely manage to undo my belt, and sit down. <LINE> <LINE> My stomach releases. <LINE> <LINE> I begin to relieve myself and breathe out calmly for the first time in the entire dream.
IGUI_Dream207: I stand at the open door of an airplane. Below, fields are divided into neat squares by roads and tree lines. The instructor slaps my shoulder and gives a thumbs-up. <LINE> <LINE> I jump. <LINE> <LINE> The wind immediately drowns out everything. The ground slowly turns beneath me. For several seconds I simply fall with my arms spread, then pull the ripcord. <LINE> <LINE> Nothing. <LINE> <LINE> I pull again. <LINE> <LINE> Only a tangled piece of fabric opens behind me. The lines lash my arms and wrap around my neck. <LINE> <LINE> I grab the reserve handle. It will not move. <LINE> <LINE> The ground rushes closer. I can already see individual trees, a fence, and the red roof of a barn. I scream, though there is almost no air. <LINE> <LINE> Impact. <LINE> <LINE> For an instant everything turns white. <LINE> <LINE> My body bounces off the ground and falls again. I hear a dry crack, but at first there is no pain. <LINE> <LINE> I lie with my cheek in the grass. In front of my eyes are tiny green blades, drops of dew, and an ant crawling over the soil. <LINE> <LINE> I try to breathe. <LINE> <LINE> My chest does not move. <LINE> <LINE> Far away, the airplane engine is still running. <LINE> <LINE> The grass slowly darkens. <LINE> <LINE> The ant disappears from sight. <LINE> <LINE> Then everything else disappears.

IGUI_CQFish_HintDefault: Hover a row to see what it means.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyTimeGood: Dawn and dusk - fish are feeding.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyTempFair: A little too warm or too cold - fish are slower.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyTempBad: Far too warm or too cold - very few bites.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyRain: Rain is the best weather to fish in.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyWeatherNormal: Clear. Rain would be better, fog worse.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyWindBad: Strong wind is chopping up the surface.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyRodGood: Takes full tension before the line gives.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyRodWeak: A crafted rod - less room to fight a fish.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyLine: Wears down as you fight fish. Replace it before it snaps.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyLineWorn: Nearly worn through - it will snap soon.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyNoHook: Without a hook nothing will bite at all.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyHookGood: A proper hook - the best bite chance there is.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyHookWeak: An improvised hook - noticeably fewer bites.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyBait: What decides WHICH fish you catch. See the Fish tab.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyNoBait: Put bait on the hook before casting.
IGUI_CQFish_SizeOddsNote: Your skill decides how big a fish you land. Casting close to the shore shifts this back towards small.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyTooHeavy: Too heavy for your skill - you cannot hook one yet.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyPredator: Only takes a moving line. Keep tension on the rod or it will never bite.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyTrophy: A rare roll at Fishing 8 and above can push one past its usual maximum.
IGUI_CQFish_WhyNoSizes: Always caught at the same size.
IGUI_CQFish_NeverCaught: You have never landed one of these.
IGUI_CQFish_CaughtBeforeLogging: Caught before this panel started keeping records - the next one will be logged.
IGUI_CQFish_BaitHidden: Catch one of these to learn what it takes.
IGUI_CQFish_NoBait: No bait works on this one.
IGUI_CQFish_Step1: 1.   Equip the rod in both hands, then aim at the water.
IGUI_CQFish_Step2: 2.   Hold the left mouse button to cast.
IGUI_CQFish_Step3: 3.   The line tightens when something takes the bait.
IGUI_CQFish_Step4: 4.   Hold the left mouse button to reel in, right click to give line.
IGUI_CQFish_TensionNote: Hold the left mouse button to reel in, the right to give line. Keep the needle out of the red or the line snaps.
IGUI_CQFish_LegendBands: The size bar splits a fish's length range into the three sizes it can be caught at. The band past its usual maximum is only reached by a trophy roll. The pale mark is your own best.
IGUI_CQFish_LegendPips: Bait is rated out of five for each fish. Green pips mean it is in your bags.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15Stockman_desc: Working beside a cattle dog teaches you to handle animals and to move quietly among them.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15OnPoint_desc: A trained protection dog at your side steadies your nerves and your aim.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15Deterrent_desc: Nothing comes close with a dog this size beside you, and it shoulders part of your load.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15Rescue_desc: A rescue dog keeps you moving well past where you would have stopped, and caring for it teaches you medicine.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15Lifeguard_desc: Keeping pace with a water rescue dog builds your wind and your conditioning.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15Draft_desc: A dog bred to pull carts to market carries a real share of your load, and works the plot beside you.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15Coursing_desc: Keeping up with a coursing hound is a training programme in itself.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15RabbitRun_desc: A hound bred to work rabbit shows you where the runs are and how to set for them.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15ColdTrail_desc: Following a nose like this one teaches you to read a trail that has long gone cold.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15LapWarmer_desc: It cannot fight, hunt, or carry. It is warm, it is yours, and that turns out to be enough.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15WaterDog_desc: A working water dog knows where the fish are holding, and brings back what it takes.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_BP15Ratter_desc: Going to ground after vermin teaches you to move unseen and to finish things at knife range.

IGUI_VM_Desc_EngineOil: Engine lubricating oil. Crucial to prevent engine friction, knocking, and seizure. Consumption is calculated over distance. Needs clean or dirty rags to check level.

IGUI_VM_Desc_Radiator: Radiator system. Coolant leaks out if damaged. Radiator is damaged during front-end collisions (zombies, trees).

IGUI_TheZims_AboutBody: The Zims is the base. On its own it draws nothing in the world: what it brings is the frame every expansion plugs into - the drawing library, the theme, the 3D portrait and this window.|#How to use|Pick an expansion in the menu on the left. Each one tells you what it does, whether you have it, and gives you a switch to turn it on or off without touching the mod list or restarting.|Cards shown in solid blue are still being built. They are there so you can see what is coming; there is nothing to open inside them yet.|#One family, one look|Every piece is its own mod, updated on its own. The base keeps them looking like one thing: same colours, same rounded shapes, one window and one key.|#Controller|Point the stick at an option and it lights up: the wheel reads the angle you are aiming at, the way a weapon wheel does. A confirms, B goes back a level, LB and RB turn the page. A direction only moves the highlight, it never confirms. Your survivor stands still while the wheel is open.|#Compatibility|Tested alongside the NeatUI family with no conflicts. Nothing here replaces game systems: The Zims draws, it does not rewrite. If you hit a conflict with any mod, please report it - silent breakage is the one thing that cannot be fixed.|#What is coming|Animations on the pieces that open and close. Zim Panel, the status HUD with the 3D portrait, need bars, moodles and body condition. Zim Bath, a real bath in a bathtub. And more after those.
IGUI_TheZims_DlcActions: Replaces the loose vanilla progress bar with one anchored under your character, showing what you are actually doing. Its settings live in this window.
IGUI_TheZims_DlcBalloons: A thought balloon floats over your survivor's head showing what bothers them most: hunger, thirst, pain, panic and more. Uses the game's own moodle icons. Works on its own, no setup needed.
IGUI_TheZims_DlcBath: Take a real bath in a bathtub: your survivor gets in, washes, and comes out calmer. Hot water and soap make it count for more.

If you would rather not, that is fine: The Zims works as the base for the other pieces. <LINE> <LINE>This message will not show again. Press K any time to see what is available.

IGUI_PoolTables_Manual_S1_Body: Equip a Pool Cue (Base.Poolcue) in either hand, then right-click a pool table and choose Play Pool. Pick a mode: Solo Practice for a free table with no rules, or a ruleset match against the AI or another player.
IGUI_PoolTables_Manual_S2_Body: Move the mouse near the cue ball to aim - the stick follows your cursor. Click and drag away from the cue ball to pull the stick back, then release to shoot: the farther you pull, the harder the shot. For fine adjustments, use the mouse wheel or the [ and ] keys - the pockets forgive less than a degree of error, so small corrections matter.
IGUI_PoolTables_Manual_S3_Body: A shot is a foul if the cue ball is pocketed, if it hits nothing, or if nothing reaches a cushion after contact. After any foul, the other player gets ball in hand: click anywhere on the table to place the cue ball before shooting (behind the line on the break).
IGUI_PoolTables_Manual_S4_Body: Standard rules. The table stays open after the break. The first ball legally potted afterwards assigns Solids or Stripes to each player. Once your group is cleared, pot the 8 to win - but potting the 8 early, on a foul, or before clearing your group loses the game instantly.
IGUI_PoolTables_Manual_S5_Body: A simpler, faster match: any ball counts, there are no groups and no early-8 penalty. Potting a ball scores a point and keeps your turn; missing passes it. When the table is cleared, whoever scored more wins. Pick this when you want a quick free-for-all rather than the teams that 8-Ball uses.
IGUI_PoolTables_Manual_S7_Body: On a server, pick Multiplayer to open a lobby. Only you need a pool cue - the table is set up with it and everyone is assumed to pass it around, so your friends can join empty-handed. Others right-click the same table and choose Play Pool to take a seat, or you can invite anyone nearby with the Invite Players button. When everyone is in, press Start Match: the game counts who is at the table and sizes the match to fit, up to 8 players. In 8-Ball the extra players form two teams, odd seats against even. Anyone can also choose Watch Pool Game to spectate without playing.
IGUI_PoolTables_Manual_S8_Body: Finished matches are recorded. Open Stats from the menu to see the rankings: on a server you can compare the leaderboard for that specific table against the whole server, and in singleplayer you get your own career record. Wins, win rate, pot rate and fouls are all tracked. None of this is stored in your save file, so removing the mod remains safe.
IGUI_PoolTables_CommunityBody: Suggestions, bug reports, or just to chat - come say hello:
IGUI_PoolTables_LinkCopied: Copied! Paste it into your browser.
IGUI_PoolTables_Manual_S6_Body: Playing lowers Boredom while the table is open, and finishing a match also eases Unhappiness and Stress, at the cost of a little Fatigue. The longer and more actively you play, the more it pays out.

IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_labrador: A hunting dog built to bring it back: it trains Hunting twice as fast, with Obedience close behind. By design it is the worst fighter in the family - the weakest bite, no knockdown, and a brawl leaves it badly rattled. Its gift is its mouth. It brings its kills back to you from the moment it can hunt, instead of waiting for a high Hunting skill, never drops one on the way, and often turns up carrying something else it found (Soft Mouth). Common in homes, and hangs around hunting cabins, campsites, boathouses and ranger stations. Butchering what it brings you also comes easier with it around.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_SoftMouth_desc: Your Labrador brings back every kill from its first hunt on, and often something extra. While it is nearby, fed and loyal, you also learn Butchering and Short Blade faster.

IGUI_GridInv_OptionsFullscreenPanel_Tool: When enabled (default), the inventory panel fills half of the screen and cannot be moved or resized. Disable to restore the native movable and resizable panel. NOTE: if you disable it with a save already loaded, you must restart the game (reload the save) for the windows to become resizable again.
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMultiContainerInv_To: When enabled (default), all open backpacks are rendered in the player inventory grid. Disable to render only the selected container (better performance).
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsMultiContainerLoot_T: When enabled (default), all loot containers on screen are rendered. Disable to render only the active container (better performance).
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsCloseOnEsc_Tooltip: When enabled (default), pressing ESC closes the inventory, loot and PaperDoll panels instead of opening the main menu. Disable to restore the vanilla behavior (ESC always opens the main menu).
IGUI_GridInv_OptionsUiScale_Tooltip: Scales the size of the inventory grids (cells, items, headers). 100 is the default (full size). Increase it on high-resolution (e.g. 4K) displays to make the interface bigger and easier to read. Applies to open panels immediately after clicking OK.
